def label(text='', cls=None, xalign=0):
    w = Gtk.Label(label=text, xalign=xalign)
    if cls:
        w.add_css_class(cls)
    return w


def button(text, callback, tooltip=None):
    b = Gtk.Button(label=text)
    b.connect('clicked', callback)
    if tooltip:
        b.set_tooltip_text(tooltip)
    return b


class StationPanel(Gtk.Box):
    """Saved station intent; selection and editing never initiate playback."""
    def __init__(self, app):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=6)
        self.app = app
        self.stations = []
        self.fingerprint = None
        self.append(label('Your stations', 'section-title'))
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.selector = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Save a source as a station'])
        self.selector.set_hexpand(True)
        row.append(self.selector)
        self.start = button('Tune in', lambda _: self.tune())
        self.start.set_sensitive(False)
        row.append(self.start)
        self.remove_station = button('Remove station', lambda _: self.delete_station())
        self.remove_station.set_sensitive(False)
        row.append(self.remove_station)
        self.append(row)
        self.note = label('Saved stations remember their source. Browsing does not start playback.', 'muted')
        self.append(self.note)
        options = Gtk.Expander(label='Station preferences and upcoming')
        body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=6)
        self.station_name = Gtk.Entry()
        self.station_name.set_placeholder_text('Station name')
        body.append(self.station_name)
        body.append(label('Preferences guide future tracks. Likely instrumental uses model scores when available; estimates can be wrong. Strict instrumental requires an exact-recording human review and can leave no music.', 'muted'))
        self.preferences = {}
        for key, title, choices in [
            ('energy', 'Energy', ['Any', 'Low', 'High']),
            ('familiarity', 'Familiarity', ['Any', 'Familiar', 'New']),
            ('speech', 'Speech', ['Any', 'Less speech', 'Speech welcome', 'Likely instrumental', 'Strict instrumental']),
            ('stay_close', 'Range', ['Any', 'Stay close', 'Explore'])]:
            line = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
            caption = label(title)
            caption.set_size_request(100, -1)
            line.append(caption)
            choice = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(choices)
            choice.set_hexpand(True)
            line.append(choice)
            body.append(line)
            self.preferences[key] = (choice, choices)
        generation_row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        generation_row.append(label('Library programming'))
        self.generation = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Selected collection', 'AudioMuse mix from track'])
        generation_row.append(self.generation)
        body.append(generation_row)
        self.generation_note = label('AudioMuse needs a Jellyfin track and a configured AudioMuse connection.', 'muted')
        body.append(self.generation_note)
        arc_row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        arc_row.append(label('Energy over time'))
        self.arc = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Keep steady', 'Wind down', 'Rise'])
        arc_row.append(self.arc)
        body.append(arc_row)
        body.append(label('The target changes every three tracks; energy uses available genre hints and may not be audible.', 'muted'))
        feedback = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.more = button('More like this', lambda _: self.app.experience.command('station.feedback', {'rating': 'more'}))
        self.less = button('Less like this', lambda _: self.app.experience.command('station.feedback', {'rating': 'less'}))
        self.hold = Gtk.CheckButton(label='Hold mood')
        self.hold.connect('toggled', self.hold_changed)
        feedback.append(self.more); feedback.append(self.less); feedback.append(self.hold)
        body.append(feedback)
        body.append(button('Reset station memory', lambda _: self.reset_memory()))
        body.append(label('Feedback changes later tracks. Hold mood pauses the energy arc.', 'muted'))
        self.hold_updating = False
        policy = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        policy.append(label('When the library ends'))
        self.end_policy = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Stop', 'Repeat'])
        policy.append(self.end_policy)
        policy.append(button('Save preferences', lambda _: self.save_preferences()))
        body.append(policy)
        body.append(label('Approved fallback sources', 'section-title'))
        body.append(label('If the primary source cannot start, try these sources in order.', 'muted'))
        self.fallback_source = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Save another station to add its source'])
        self.fallback_source.set_hexpand(True)
        self.fallback_choices = []
        fallback_row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        fallback_row.append(self.fallback_source)
        fallback_row.append(button('Add fallback', lambda _: self.add_fallback()))
        fallback_row.append(button('Remove last', lambda _: self.remove_fallback()))
        body.append(fallback_row)
        self.fallback_note = label('No fallbacks approved.', 'muted')
        body.append(self.fallback_note)
        body.append(label('Repeat is available for library stations when next tuned in.', 'muted'))
        self.upcoming = label('Tune in to a library station to see upcoming tracks.', 'muted')
        body.append(self.upcoming)
        options.set_child(body)
        self.append(options)
        self.selector.connect('notify::selected', lambda *_: self.load_preferences())

    def delete_station(self):
        station = self.selected()
        if station:
            self.app.experience.command('station.delete', {'id': station['id']})

    def reset_memory(self):
        station = self.selected()
        if station:
            self.app.experience.command('station.reset_memory', {'id': station['id']})
        else:
            self.app.set_message('Choose a saved station first.', True)

    def hold_changed(self, widget):
        if not self.hold_updating:
            self.app.experience.command('station.hold', {'hold': widget.get_active()})

    def add_fallback(self):
        index = self.fallback_source.get_selected()
        if index >= len(self.fallback_choices) or not self.selected():
            self.app.set_message('Choose a station and a different saved source first.', True)
            return
        source = self.fallback_choices[index]
        if source not in self.pending_fallbacks:
            self.pending_fallbacks.append(dict(source))
        self.show_fallbacks()

    def remove_fallback(self):
        if self.pending_fallbacks:
            self.pending_fallbacks.pop()
        self.show_fallbacks()

    def show_fallbacks(self):
        self.fallback_note.set_text(' → '.join(x.get('name') or x.get('source_id') or (x.get('reference') or {}).get('name') or 'Source' for x in self.pending_fallbacks) or 'No fallbacks approved.')

    def load_preferences(self):
        station = self.selected() or {}
        self.station_name.set_text(station.get('name', ''))
        prefs = station.get('preferences') or {}
        for key, (dropdown, choices) in self.preferences.items():
            value = prefs.get(key, 'Any')
            dropdown.set_selected(choices.index(value) if value in choices else 0)
        self.end_policy.set_selected(1 if station.get('end_policy') == 'repeat' else 0)
        self.arc.set_selected({'none': 0, 'wind_down': 1, 'rise': 2}.get(station.get('arc'), 0))
        reference = ((station.get('sources') or [{}])[0].get('reference') or {})
        can_generate = reference.get('provider') == 'jellyfin' and str(reference.get('type', '')).lower() in ('audio', 'track', 'song')
        self.generation.set_sensitive(bool(can_generate))
        self.generation.set_selected(1 if (station.get('generation') or {}).get('kind') == 'audiomuse' else 0)
        self.pending_fallbacks = [dict(x) for x in station.get('fallbacks', [])]
        self.fallback_choices = [x['sources'][0] for x in self.stations if x.get('id') != station.get('id') and x.get('sources')]
        self.fallback_source.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new([x.get('name') or x.get('source_id') or (x.get('reference') or {}).get('name') or 'Source' for x in self.fallback_choices] or ['Save another station to add its source']))
        self.show_fallbacks()

    def save_preferences(self):
        station = self.selected()
        if not station:
            self.app.set_message('Choose a saved station first.', True)
            return
        name = self.station_name.get_text().strip()
        if not name:
            self.app.set_message('Enter a name for this station.', True)
            return
        edited = dict(station)
        edited['name'] = name
        edited['preferences'] = {key: choices[dropdown.get_selected()] for key, (dropdown, choices) in self.preferences.items()}
        edited['end_policy'] = 'repeat' if self.end_policy.get_selected() else 'stop'
        edited['fallbacks'] = list(self.pending_fallbacks)
        edited['arc'] = ['none', 'wind_down', 'rise'][self.arc.get_selected()]
        edited['generation'] = {'kind': 'audiomuse' if self.generation.get_selected() == 1 else 'collection'}
        self.app.experience.command('station.save', {'station': edited}, after=lambda _: self.app.set_message('Station preferences saved.'))

    def save_reference(self, item):
        station = {'name': item.get('name') or 'Library station', 'sources': [{'reference': item}],
                   'preferences': {}, 'fallbacks': [], 'end_policy': 'stop'}
        self.app.experience.command('station.save', {'station': station}, after=lambda _: self.app.set_message('Station saved.'))

    def selected(self):
        index = self.selector.get_selected()
        return self.stations[index] if index < len(self.stations) else None

    def save_source(self, item):
        source = {'source_id': item.get('id'), 'url': item.get('url'), 'name': item.get('name')}
        source = {key: value for key, value in source.items() if value}
        station = {'name': item.get('name') or 'Station', 'sources': [source],
                   'preferences': {}, 'fallbacks': [], 'end_policy': 'stop'}
        self.app.experience.command('station.save', {'station': station},
                                    after=lambda _: self.app.set_message('Station saved.'))

    def tune(self):
        station = self.selected()
        if station:
            self.app.experience.command('station.start', {'id': station['id']}, show_inside=True)

    def render(self, snapshot):
        stations = snapshot.get('stations') or []
        fingerprint = json.dumps(stations, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
        if fingerprint != self.fingerprint:
            old = self.selected()
            self.stations = stations
            self.selector.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new([x.get('name', 'Station') for x in stations]
                                                       or ['Save a source as a station']))
            if old:
                self.selector.set_selected(next((i for i, x in enumerate(stations) if x.get('id') == old.get('id')), 0))
            self.start.set_sensitive(bool(stations))
            self.remove_station.set_sensitive(bool(stations))
            self.fingerprint = fingerprint
            self.load_preferences()
        if hasattr(self.app, 'metadata_panel'):
            self.app.metadata_panel.render(snapshot)
        program = snapshot.get('station') or {}
        self.hold_updating = True
        self.hold.set_active(bool(program.get('hold')))
        self.hold_updating = False
        self.hold.set_sensitive(bool(program))
        self.more.set_sensitive(bool(program.get('current')))
        self.less.set_sensitive(bool(program.get('current')))
        upcoming = program.get('upcoming') or []
        self.upcoming.set_text(('Upcoming: ' + ', '.join(x.get('name') or 'Track' for x in upcoming)) if upcoming else 'No upcoming library tracks available.')
        recent = snapshot.get('station_recent') or []
        room_recent = snapshot.get('recent') or []
        rooms = self.app.snapshot.get('rooms') or []
        variants = snapshot.get('variants') or []
        recent_fingerprint = json.dumps([recent, room_recent, rooms, variants], sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
        if recent_fingerprint != getattr(self, 'recent_fingerprint', None):
            self.recent_fingerprint = recent_fingerprint
            box = self.app.recent_list
            while box.get_first_child():
                box.remove(box.get_first_child())
            box.append(label('Recent listening', 'section-title'))
            if not recent and not room_recent:
                box.append(label('Stations and rooms you enter will appear here.', 'muted'))
            for item in recent:
                row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
                title = label((item.get('station') or {}).get('name') or 'Station')
                title.set_hexpand(True)
                row.append(title)
                replay = button('Replay', lambda _, identity=item.get('id'): self.app.experience.command('station.replay', {'id': identity}, show_inside=True))
                replay.set_sensitive(bool(item.get('tracks')))
                if not item.get('tracks'):
                    replay.set_tooltip_text('This live source did not provide recorded track references to replay.')
                row.append(replay)
                box.append(row)
            known = {item.get('id'): item for item in rooms}
            saved = {item.get('id'): item for item in variants}
            for identity in room_recent:
                if identity in saved:
                    item = saved[identity]
                    row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
                    title = label(item.get('name') or 'Saved room'); title.set_hexpand(True); row.append(title)
                    row.append(button('Enter room', lambda _, key=identity: self.app.experience.command('enter', {'variant_id': key}, show_inside=True)))
                    box.append(row)
                elif identity in known:
                    item = known[identity]
                    row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
                    title = label(item.get('name') or 'Room'); title.set_hexpand(True); row.append(title)
                    row.append(button('Preview room', lambda _, key=identity: self.app.preview_room_action(None, GLib.Variant('s', key))))
                    box.append(row)


class MetadataPanel(Gtk.Expander):
    """Explicit metadata and exact-recording review for the selected library track."""
    def __init__(self, app):
        super().__init__(label='Metadata')
        self.app = app
        self.record = None; self.jobs = []; self.pending = False; self.last_item = None
        self.match_jobs = {}; self.candidates = []; self.candidate_fingerprint = None
        self.worker = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix='room-metadata')
        body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=6)
        self.set_child(body)
        self.detail = label('Select a library track to inspect its metadata.', 'muted')
        self.detail.set_wrap(True); self.detail.set_selectable(True)
        body.append(self.detail)
        actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=6)
        self.enrich_buttons = []
        for title, mode in [('Enrich', 'enrich'), ('Match', 'match'), ('Analyze', 'analyze')]:
            control = button(title, lambda _, m=mode: self.enrich(m))
            actions.append(control); self.enrich_buttons.append(control)
        body.append(actions)
        match_method = Gtk.Box(spacing=6)
        match_method.append(label('Match using'))
        self.match_method = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['MusicBrainz text search', 'AcoustID audio fingerprint'])
        match_method.append(self.match_method)
        body.append(match_method)
        match_help = label('Match sends track details to MusicBrainz, or an audio fingerprint to AcoustID. AcoustID needs a configured application key and fingerprint tool.', 'muted')
        match_help.set_wrap(True); body.append(match_help)
        setup = Gtk.Expander(label='AcoustID setup')
        setup_body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=6)
        setup.set_child(setup_body)
        note = label('Optional: register an AcoustID application to get a client key. MusicBrainz search works without it.', 'muted')
        note.set_wrap(True); setup_body.append(note)
        register = Gtk.LinkButton.new_with_label('https://acoustid.org/new-application', 'Register an AcoustID application')
        setup_body.append(register)
        self.acoustid_status = label('Checking setup…', 'muted'); setup_body.append(self.acoustid_status)
        setup_body.append(label('Application client key'))
        self.acoustid_key = Gtk.PasswordEntry()
        setup_body.append(self.acoustid_key)
        key_actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=6)
        key_actions.append(button('Save key', lambda _: self.save_acoustid_key()))
        key_actions.append(button('Remove saved key', lambda _: self.save_acoustid_key(clear=True)))
        setup_body.append(key_actions)
        body.append(setup)
        bulk = Gtk.Box(spacing=6)
        bulk.append(button('Enrich shown tracks', lambda _: self.enrich_shown()))
        bulk.append(button('Enrich upcoming', lambda _: self.enrich_upcoming()))
        body.append(bulk)
        match_row = Gtk.Box(spacing=6)
        self.candidate_choice = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['No identity candidates'])
        self.candidate_choice.set_hexpand(True)
        self.confirm_identity = button('Confirm identity', lambda _: self.confirm_match())
        match_row.append(self.candidate_choice); match_row.append(self.confirm_identity)
        body.append(match_row)
        match_note = label('Identity candidates are suggestions. Confirming an identity is separate from reviewing the audio.', 'muted')
        match_note.set_wrap(True); body.append(match_note)
        self.progress = label('No metadata jobs.', 'muted'); self.progress.set_wrap(True)
        body.append(self.progress)
        self.cancel = button('Cancel current metadata job', lambda _: self.cancel_job())
        body.append(self.cancel)
        review = Gtk.Expander(label='Review this exact recording')
        review_body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=6)
        review.set_child(review_body)
        explanation = label('Listen to the whole exact recording yourself before reviewing. The review applies only to the audio version checked by the controller; replacement audio needs a new review. Reviewing does not start playback.', 'muted')
        explanation.set_wrap(True); review_body.append(explanation)
        self.review_class = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Instrumental (no vocals or speech)', 'Vocals', 'Spoken word', 'Unknown'])
        review_body.append(self.review_class)
        self.reviewer = Gtk.Entry(); self.reviewer.set_placeholder_text('Your name or review identifier')
        review_body.append(self.reviewer)
        self.ack = Gtk.CheckButton(label='I listened to the entire exact recording')
        review_body.append(self.ack)
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=6)
        self.review_button = button('Save review', lambda _: self.review())
        self.revoke_button = button('Revoke review', lambda _: self.revoke())
        row.append(self.review_button); row.append(self.revoke_button); review_body.append(row)
        body.append(review)
        self.render({})
        self.timer = GLib.timeout_add_seconds(2, self.refresh)
        self.refresh()

    def close(self):
        GLib.source_remove(self.timer)
        self.worker.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)

    def refresh(self):
        if self.pending or self.app.closed: return True
        self.pending = True
        item = self.selected()
        def fetch():
            record = session_client.request('metadata.lookup_reference', {'reference': item}, timeout=3).get('record') if item else None
            return (record, session_client.request('metadata.jobs', {}, timeout=3), session_client.request('metadata.status', {}, timeout=3))
        def done(f):
            try: result, error = f.result(), None
            except Exception as exc: result, error = None, str(exc)
            def apply():
                self.pending = False
                if self.app.closed: return False
                if error:
                    self.record = None
                    self.render(self.app.experience.snapshot)
                    self.progress.set_text('Metadata unavailable: ' + error)
                else:
                    if item == self.selected(): self.record = result[0]
                    self.jobs = result[1].get('jobs') or []
                    self.acoustid_status.set_text('Client key configured.' if result[2].get('acoustid_ready') else 'No client key configured.')
                    self.render(self.app.experience.snapshot)
                return False
            GLib.idle_add(apply)
        self.worker.submit(fetch).add_done_callback(done)
        return True

    def save_acoustid_key(self, clear=False):
        value = '' if clear else self.acoustid_key.get_text().strip()
        if not clear and not value:
            self.app.set_message('Enter the AcoustID application client key.', True); return
        self.acoustid_key.set_text('')
        self.app.experience.command('metadata.configure_acoustid', {'client_key': value}, after=lambda _: self.refresh())

    def selected(self):
        item = self.app.connections.selected
        return dict(item) if item and item.get('provider') == 'jellyfin' and item.get('type') == 'Audio' else None

    def enrich(self, mode):
        item = self.selected()
        if item:
            def accepted(result):
                if mode == 'match': self.match_jobs[item['id']] = result.get('job_id')
                self.refresh()
            params = {'reference': item}
            if mode == 'match': params['method'] = 'acoustid' if self.match_method.get_selected() else 'musicbrainz'
            self.app.experience.command('metadata.' + ('enrich' if mode == 'all' else mode), params, after=accepted)

    def confirm_match(self):
        item = self.selected()
        index = self.candidate_choice.get_selected()
        if item and index < len(self.candidates):
            self.app.experience.command('metadata.confirm_identity', {'job_id': self.match_jobs[item['id']], 'provider_id': self.candidates[index]['provider_id']})


    def enrich_shown(self):
        items = [dict(x) for x in self.app.connections.library_items if x.get('provider') == 'jellyfin' and x.get('type') == 'Audio'][:100]
        if not items:
            self.app.set_message('Browse tracks first.', True); return
        self.enqueue(items)

    def enrich_upcoming(self):
        station = self.app.experience.snapshot.get('station') or {}
        items = [dict(x) for x in (station.get('upcoming') or []) if x.get('provider') == 'jellyfin' and x.get('type') == 'Audio'][:20]
        if not items:
            self.app.set_message('No upcoming Jellyfin tracks to enrich.', True); return
        self.enqueue(items)

    def enqueue(self, items):
        total = len(items)
        items = items[:20]
        def submit():
            accepted = 0
            for item in items:
                try: session_client.request('metadata.enrich', {'reference': item}, timeout=5); accepted += 1
                except (ValueError, OSError): break
            return accepted
        self.app.run_task(submit, success=lambda n: self.app.set_message(f'Queued {n} of {total} tracks. Up to 20 can be queued at once.'), executor=self.worker)

    def cancel_job(self):
        if self.job: self.app.experience.command('metadata.cancel', {'job_id': self.job.get('job_id')})

    def review(self):
        item = self.selected()
        reviewer = self.reviewer.get_text().strip()
        if not item or not self.ack.get_active() or not reviewer:
            self.app.set_message('Listen to the whole recording, confirm the review scope and enter your name.', True); return
        if not self.record: return
        self.app.experience.command('metadata.review', {'origin': self.record['origin'], 'item_id': self.record['item_id'], 'classification': ['instrumental', 'vocal', 'spoken', 'unknown'][self.review_class.get_selected()], 'reviewer': reviewer, 'acknowledged': True}, after=lambda _: self.ack.set_active(False))

    def revoke(self):
        item = self.selected()
        if item and self.record: self.app.experience.command('metadata.revoke', {'origin': self.record['origin'], 'item_id': self.record['item_id']})

    def render(self, snapshot):
        item = self.selected()
        identity = item.get('id') if item else None
        if identity != self.last_item:
            self.ack.set_active(False); self.last_item = identity; self.record = None
            self.refresh()
        record = self.record
        match_id = self.match_jobs.get(identity)
        match = next((j for j in self.jobs if j.get('job_id') == match_id and j.get('status') == 'completed'), None)
        candidates = ((match or {}).get('result') or {}).get('candidates') or []
        fingerprint = json.dumps(candidates, sort_keys=True)
        if fingerprint != self.candidate_fingerprint:
            self.candidate_fingerprint = fingerprint; self.candidates = candidates
            self.candidate_choice.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new([str(c.get('title') or c.get('provider_id')) + ' (' + str(c.get('provider', 'unknown')) + ')' for c in candidates] or ['No identity candidates']))
        self.confirm_identity.set_sensitive(bool(item and candidates))
        for control in self.enrich_buttons: control.set_sensitive(bool(item))
        self.review_button.set_sensitive(bool(item and record))
        self.revoke_button.set_sensitive(bool(item and record and record.get('review')))
        jobs = self.jobs
        self.job = next((j for j in jobs if j.get('status') in ('queued', 'running')), None)
        self.cancel.set_sensitive(bool(self.job))
        self.progress.set_text((str(self.job.get('kind', 'Metadata')).capitalize() + ': ' + str(self.job.get('status')) + ' (' + str(sum(j.get('status') in ('queued', 'running') for j in jobs)) + ' pending)') if self.job else (str(jobs[-1].get('message') or jobs[-1].get('status')) if jobs else 'No metadata jobs.'))
        if not item:
            self.detail.set_text('Select a library track to inspect its metadata.'); return
        lines = [item.get('name') or 'Track', item.get('artist') or 'Artist unknown']
        station = snapshot.get('station') or {}
        current = station.get('current') or {}
        reasons = station.get('explanation') or []
        if current.get('id') == item.get('id') and reasons:
            lines.append('Why this selection: ' + '; '.join(str(x) for x in reasons))
        else:
            lines.append('Selection reasons are available for the current station track.')
        if not record:
            lines.append('No metadata for this recording yet. Choose Enrich, Match or Analyze.')
        else:
            lines.append(('Audio version: SHA256 ' + str(record['audio_sha256'])) if record.get('audio_sha256') else 'Audio version has not been fingerprinted yet.')
            for obs in record.get('identities') or []:
                lines.append('Identity: ' + str(obs.get('name') or obs.get('provider_id') or obs.get('value') or 'Unknown') + ' (source: ' + str(obs.get('provider', 'unknown')) + ', confidence: ' + str(obs.get('confidence', 'unknown')) + ', status: ' + str(obs.get('status', 'unconfirmed')) + ')')
            if not record.get('identities'): lines.append('Recording identity not matched.')
            for obs in record.get('features') or []:
                name = str(obs.get('name', 'feature'))
                source = str(obs.get('provider', 'unknown'))
                if name in ('instrumental score', 'voice score'):
                    scope = 'whole recording, audio version above' if record.get('audio_sha256') and obs.get('provider') == 'Essentia MTG' else 'audio version unknown'
                    lines.append('Uncalibrated model score: ' + name + ' = ' + str(obs.get('value', 'unknown')) + ' (source: ' + source + '; ' + scope + '; not a probability or human review)')
                else:
                    lines.append('Estimate: ' + name + ' = ' + str(obs.get('value', 'unknown')) + ' (source: ' + source + ', confidence: ' + str(obs.get('confidence', 'unknown')) + ')')
            for obs in record.get('unbound_features') or []:
                lines.append('Uncalibrated estimate: ' + str(obs.get('name', 'feature')) + ' = ' + str(obs.get('value', 'unknown')) + ' (source: ' + str(obs.get('provider', 'unknown')) + '; audio version unknown)')
            if not record.get('features') and not record.get('unbound_features'): lines.append('No audio estimates available.')
            review = record.get('review')
            lines.append(('Human review: ' + str(review.get('classification')) + ' by ' + str(review.get('reviewer')) + ' on ' + str(review.get('date'))) if review else 'No human review for this audio version.')
            lines.append('Last checked: ' + str(record.get('updated_at', 'unknown')) + '. Review validity is checked again before use.')
        self.detail.set_text('\n'.join(lines))


class Room(Gtk.Application):
    def __init__(self, mode='browse', preview_link=None):
        self.initial_mode = mode
        self.initial_link = preview_link
        super().__init__(application_id='app.kotona.ListeningRoom', flags=Gio.ApplicationFlags.HANDLES_COMMAND_LINE)
        self.executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
        self.snapshot = {}
        self.poll_pending = False
        self.closed = False
        self.updating = False
        self.scale_timers = {}
        self.scale_editing = set()
        self.player_ids = []
        self.presets = []
        self.scene_items = []
        self.profile_items = []
        self.sources_fingerprint = None
        self.search_results = []
        self.room_items = []
        self.room_fingerprint = None
        self.preview_room_id = None
        self.room_launching = False

    def do_command_line(self, command_line):
        arguments = list(command_line.get_arguments())[1:]
        try:
            mode, link = launch_arguments(arguments)
        except (ValueError, SystemExit):
            return 1
        if not hasattr(self, 'window'):
            self.initial_mode, self.initial_link = mode, link
        self.activate()
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'):
            self.experience.show(mode)
            if link:
                self.experience.show('browse')
                self.connections.preview_url(link)
                page = self.connections.get_parent()
                self.notebook.set_current_page(self.notebook.page_num(page))
        return 0

    def do_activate(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'window'):
            self.window.present()
            return
        self.window = Gtk.ApplicationWindow(application=self, title='Listening room')
        self.window.set_default_size(1060, 900)
        self.window.set_size_request(760, 600)
        self.window.connect('close-request', self.on_close)
        provider = Gtk.CssProvider()
        provider.load_from_data(CSS)
        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_display(Gdk.Display.get_default(), provider, Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION)
        self.session_colors = Gtk.CssProvider()
        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_display(Gdk.Display.get_default(), self.session_colors, Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION + 2)
        self.room_colors = Gtk.CssProvider()
        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_display(Gdk.Display.get_default(), self.room_colors, Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION + 1)

        self.recent_list.set_margin_top(16)
        recent_scroll = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        recent_scroll.set_child(self.recent_list)
        notebook.append_page(recent_scroll, Gtk.Label(label='Recent'))
        for name, page in [('connections', self.connection_page), ('links', notebook.get_n_pages() - 3)]:
            action = Gio.SimpleAction.new('show-' + name, None)
            action.connect('activate', lambda _a, _p, index=page: self.show_browser(index))
            self.add_action(action)
        self.station_panel = StationPanel(self)
        self.metadata_panel = MetadataPanel(self)
        self.connections.library_list.connect('row-selected', lambda *_: self.metadata_panel.render(self.experience.snapshot))
        listen.prepend(self.station_panel)
        child = self.connections.get_first_child()
        while child:
            following = child.get_next_sibling()
            if isinstance(child, Gtk.Expander) and child.get_label() in ('Jellyfin library', 'Speakers through Music Assistant'):
                self.connections.remove(child)
                if child.get_label() == 'Jellyfin library':
                    self.library_expander = child
                    child.get_child().append(self.metadata_panel)
                else: self.remote_expander = child
                child.set_expanded(False)
                listen.append(child)
            child = following
        shortcuts = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        shortcuts.append(button('Live channels', lambda _: self.show_channels()))
        shortcuts.append(button('Jellyfin library', lambda _: self.show_library()))
        shortcuts.append(button('Music Assistant', lambda _: self.show_remote_library()))
        shortcuts.append(button('Listen from a link', lambda _: self.show_links()))
        listen.insert_child_after(shortcuts, destination_row)
        self.link_expander = Gtk.Expander(label='Listen from a link')
        self.link_expander.set_child(self.experience.links)
        listen.append(self.link_expander)
        listen.append(button('Connect music services', lambda _: self.show_browser(self.connection_page)))
        notebook.connect('switch-page', lambda _n, _p, _i: self.experience.browser_page_changed())
        notebook.set_current_page(1)
        self.experience.browser_page_changed()
        self.window.present()
        if self.initial_mode != 'browse': self.experience.show(self.initial_mode)
        if self.initial_link:
            self.connections.preview_url(self.initial_link)
            notebook.set_current_page(notebook.page_num(connection_scroll))
        self.poll()
        GLib.timeout_add_seconds(2, self.periodic)

    def on_close(self, *_):
        self.closed = True
        for timer in self.scale_timers.values():
            GLib.source_remove(timer)
        self.scale_timers.clear()
        self.world_radio.close()
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'): self.experience.close()
        if hasattr(self, 'connections'): self.connections.close()
        if hasattr(self, 'metadata_panel'): self.metadata_panel.close()
        self.channels.close()
        self.executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
        return False

    def run_task(self, func, success=None, message=None, executor=None):
        if message:
            self.set_message(message)
        if self.closed: return
        future = (executor or self.executor).submit(func)
        def done(f):
            try:
                value = f.result()
                GLib.idle_add(self.task_done, success, value, None)
            except Exception as exc:
                GLib.idle_add(self.task_done, success, None, str(exc) or type(exc).__name__)
        future.add_done_callback(done)

    def task_done(self, success, value, error):
        if self.closed:
            return False
        if error:
            self.scale_editing.clear()
            self.set_message(error, True)
        else:
            if success:
                success(value)
            else:
                self.set_message('Ready')
            self.poll()
        return False

    def set_message(self, text, error=False):
        self.message.set_text(text)
        if error: self.message.add_css_class('error')
        else: self.message.remove_css_class('error')

    def periodic(self):
        if self.closed: return False
        self.poll()
        return True

    def poll(self):
        if self.poll_pending or self.closed: return
        self.poll_pending = True
        def get():
            snapshot = hub.inspect_state()
            snapshot['rooms'] = room_catalogue.rooms()
            snapshot['vista_presets'] = ambience.presets()
            snapshot['ambience'] = ambience.state('ambience')
            snapshot['video'] = ambience.state('video')
            snapshot['overlay'] = audio_layers.state()
            snapshot['overlay_settings'] = audio_layers.audio_settings()
            return snapshot
        def done(f):
            try: GLib.idle_add(self.finish_poll, f.result(), None)
            except Exception as exc: GLib.idle_add(self.finish_poll, None, str(exc))
        self.executor.submit(get).add_done_callback(done)

    def finish_poll(self, snapshot, error):
        self.poll_pending = False
        if self.closed: return False
        if error:
            self.set_message('Could not refresh: ' + error, True)
            return False
        self.snapshot = snapshot
        self.render_state()
        if self.message.get_text().startswith('Loading') or self.message.get_text().startswith('Could not refresh:'):
            self.set_message('Ready')
        return False

    @staticmethod
    def dropdown(dropdown, entries, current=0):
        labels = entries or ['None available']
        model = dropdown.get_model()
        old = [model.get_string(i) for i in range(model.get_n_items())] if isinstance(model, Gtk.StringList) else []
        if old != labels:
            dropdown.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new(labels))
        position = min(current, len(labels) - 1)
        if dropdown.get_selected() != position:
            dropdown.set_selected(position)

    def render_state(self):
        self.updating = True
        s = self.snapshot
        self.channels.update_layer(s.get('overlay'), s.get('overlay_settings') or {})
        self.world_radio.update_snapshot()
        self.render_rooms(s.get('rooms') or [])
        pause_others = bool((s.get('preferences') or {}).get('pause_others_on_radio_start', False))
        self.pause_others.set_active(pause_others)
        self.room_policy.set_text('Other players pause when radio starts.' if pause_others else 'Other players keep playing when radio starts.')
        players = s.get('players') or []
        selected = s.get('selected') or {}
        self.player_ids = [x.get('id') for x in players]
        labels = [f"{self.player_label(x.get('id'))} — {x.get('status', '')}" for x in players]
        self.dropdown(self.player, labels, self.player_ids.index(selected.get('id')) if selected.get('id') in self.player_ids else 0)
        self.player.set_sensitive(bool(players))
        title = ' — '.join(x for x in (selected.get('artist'), selected.get('title')) if x)
        self.now.set_text(title or selected.get('id') or 'Nothing playing')
        self.now_detail.set_text((selected.get('status') or 'Choose a source below to begin') + (f"  ·  {self.player_label(selected['id'])}" if selected.get('id') else ''))
        has_player = bool(selected)
        for name in ('play_pause', 'stop'):
            getattr(self, 'transport_' + name).set_sensitive(has_player)
        self.transport_next.set_sensitive(has_player and selected.get('id') != 'radio' and selected.get('can_next', True))
        self.transport_previous.set_sensitive(has_player and selected.get('id') != 'radio' and selected.get('can_previous', True))
        self.set_scale(self.source_scale, selected.get('volume'), False)
        self.set_scale(self.master_scale, (s.get('system_volume') or {}).get('percent'), True)
        self.master_mute.set_label('Unmute' if (s.get('system_volume') or {}).get('muted') else 'Mute')
        self.presets = s.get('vista_presets') or []
        self.dropdown(self.vista, [x.get('name', 'Vista') for x in self.presets], self.vista.get_selected())
        self.profile_items = s.get('profiles') or []
        self.scene_items = s.get('scenes') or []
        self.dropdown(self.profile, [self.item_name(x) for x in self.profile_items], self.profile.get_selected())
        self.dropdown(self.scene, [self.item_name(x) for x in self.scene_items], self.scene.get_selected())
        self.set_scale(self.video_scale, (s.get('video') or {}).get('volume') if isinstance(s.get('video'), dict) else None, 'video')
        self.vista_status.set_text('Vista: ' + self.activity(s.get('ambience')) + '    Video: ' + self.activity(s.get('video')))
        self.updating = False
        fingerprint = json.dumps([s.get('sources'), s.get('favorites')], sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
        if fingerprint != self.sources_fingerprint:
            self.sources_fingerprint = fingerprint
            self.render_sources()

    @staticmethod
    def player_label(player_id):
        name = str(player_id or '')
        lower = name.lower()
        if lower == 'radio': return 'Radio'
        if lower == 'video': return 'Video window'
        for key, display in [('vivaldi', 'Vivaldi'), ('firefox', 'Firefox'),
                             ('feishin', 'Jellyfin Music'), ('jellyfin', 'Jellyfin'),
                             ('kdeconnect', 'KDE Connect'), ('chromium', 'Chromium'),
                             ('chrome', 'Chrome')]:
            if key in lower:
                # Instance suffix distinguishes simultaneous browser players.
                suffix = name[len(key):] if lower.startswith(key) else ''
                return display + suffix
        return name or 'Player'

    def render_rooms(self, rooms):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'):
            rooms = room_discovery.eligible(rooms, self.experience.preference(), self.experience.recent())
        fingerprint = json.dumps(rooms, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
        if fingerprint == self.room_fingerprint:
            return
        self.room_fingerprint = fingerprint
        self.room_items = [r for r in rooms if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('id')]
        child = self.rooms_rail.get_first_child()
        while child:
            nxt = child.get_next_sibling()
            self.rooms_rail.remove(child)
            child = nxt
        selected_index = next((i for i, item in enumerate(self.room_items) if item.get('last_entered')), 0) if self.preview_room_id is None else 0
        for i, room in enumerate(self.room_items):
            row = Gtk.ListBoxRow()
            body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=3)
            title = label(room.get('name', 'Room'), 'source-name')
            title.set_ellipsize(3)
            title.set_max_width_chars(20)
            body.append(title)
            detail = label(room.get('subtitle', ''), 'muted')
            detail.set_ellipsize(3)
            detail.set_max_width_chars(22)
            body.append(detail)
            row.set_child(body)
            self.rooms_rail.append(row)
            if room['id'] == self.preview_room_id:
                selected_index = i
        if self.room_items:
            self.rooms_rail.select_row(self.rooms_rail.get_row_at_index(selected_index))
        else:
            self.preview_room_id = None
            self.update_room_preview()

    def show_room(self):
        if (self.experience.snapshot.get('active') or {}):
            self.experience.show('inside')
        else:
            self.show_browser(0)

    def show_links(self):
        self.show_browser(1)
        self.link_expander.set_expanded(True)
        self.experience.link.grab_focus()

    def show_library(self):
        self.show_browser(1)
        self.library_expander.set_expanded(True)
        self.connections.library_query.grab_focus()

    def show_remote_library(self):
        self.show_browser(1)
        self.remote_expander.set_expanded(True)
        self.connections.remote_player.grab_focus()

    def show_channels(self):
        self.show_browser(1)
        self.channels_expander.set_expanded(True)
        self.channels.search.grab_focus()

    def show_browser(self, page):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'): self.experience.show('browse')
        self.notebook.set_current_page(page)

    def room_selected(self, _box, row):
        if row is None:
            return
        index = row.get_index()
        if 0 <= index < len(self.room_items):
            self.preview_room_id = self.room_items[index]['id']
            self.update_room_preview()

    def preview_room_action(self, _action, parameter):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'): self.experience.show('browse')
        identity = parameter.get_string()
        for index, room in enumerate(self.room_items):
            if room['id'] == identity:
                self.notebook.set_current_page(0)
                self.rooms_rail.select_row(self.rooms_rail.get_row_at_index(index))
                return
        self.set_message('That room is unavailable.', True)

    def update_room_preview(self):
        room = next((x for x in self.room_items if x['id'] == self.preview_room_id), None)
        view_ready = room is not None and (not self.include_view.get_active() or bool(room.get('view_id')))
        if room and self.include_view.get_active() and self.still_view.get_active() and not room.get('still_available'):
            view_ready = False
        self.enter_room_button.set_sensitive(not self.room_launching and room is not None and room.get('available', True) and view_ready)
        if not room:
            self.room_name.set_text('No rooms available')
            self.room_description.set_text('Refresh to try again.')
            self.room_plan.set_text('')
            self.room_picture.set_filename(None)
            self.room_tone.set_text('')
            return
        self.room_name.set_text(room.get('name', 'Room'))
        self.room_description.set_text(room.get('description') or room.get('subtitle') or '')
        self.room_tone.set_text('Sound mood: ' + room['audio_tone'] if room.get('audio_tone') else '')
        self.still_view.set_sensitive(self.include_view.get_active())
        accent = room.get('accent', '')
        if re.fullmatch(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}', accent):
            self.room_colors.load_from_data(('.room-hero-title { color: ' + accent + '; } button.suggested-action { background: ' + accent + '; color: #172331; }').encode())
        else:
            self.room_colors.load_from_data(b'')
        sound = room.get('source_name') or 'Selected source'
        view = room.get('view_name') or 'Silent view'
        note = 'Sound: ' + sound
        if self.include_view.get_active():
            if room.get('view_id'):
                note += '\nView: ' + view + ' · workspace 9'
                if self.still_view.get_active():
                    note += '\nStill artwork' if room.get('still_available') else '\nStill artwork unavailable. Turn off Still artwork to continue.'
                elif room.get('motion'):
                    note += '\n' + room['motion']
            else:
                note += '\nView unavailable. Uncheck the view option for sound only.'
        else:
            note += '\nSound only'
        if room.get('source_kind') in ('web', 'discovery'):
            note += '\nOpens in your browser; use its player to start listening.'
        if not room.get('available', True):
            note += '\nThis room is currently unavailable.'
        self.room_plan.set_text(note)
        poster = room.get('poster_path')
        self.room_picture.set_filename(poster if isinstance(poster, str) and os.path.isfile(poster) else None)

    def surprise_room(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'):
            self.experience.surprise()
            return
        choices = [r for r in self.room_items if r['id'] != self.preview_room_id]
        if not choices:
            return
        chosen = random.choice(choices)
        index = self.room_items.index(chosen)
        self.rooms_rail.select_row(self.rooms_rail.get_row_at_index(index))

    def enter_room(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'):
            self.experience.enter(self.preview_room_id, self.include_view.get_active(), self.still_view.get_active())
            return
        room_id = self.preview_room_id
        include_view = self.include_view.get_active()
        still = self.still_view.get_active()
        if not room_id or self.room_launching:
            return
        self.room_launching = True
        self.update_room_preview()
        def finish_launch():
            self.room_launching = False
            if not self.closed:
                self.update_room_preview()
            return False
        def launch():
            try:
                return room_catalogue.launch_room(room_id, with_view=include_view, still=still)
            finally:
                GLib.idle_add(finish_launch)
        def complete(result):
            self.show_room_result(result, 'Room started')
        self.run_task(launch, success=complete, message='Entering room…')

    def show_room_result(self, result, fallback):
        if isinstance(result, dict):
            message = result.get('message', fallback)
            errors = result.get('errors') or []
            if errors:
                message += ' ' + '; '.join(str(error) for error in errors)
            self.set_message(message, bool(errors))
        else:
            self.set_message(str(result or fallback))

    def quiet_room(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'):
            self.experience.command('quiet')
            return
        self.channels.cancel_layer_start()
        player_id = self.visible_player_id()
        self.run_task(lambda: room_catalogue.quiet_room(target_id=player_id),
                      success=lambda result: self.show_room_result(result, 'Room quieted'),
                      message='Quieting room…')

    def stop_room(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience'):
            self.experience.command('stop')
            return
        self.channels.cancel_layer_start()
        self.run_task(room_catalogue.stop_room,
                      success=lambda result: self.show_room_result(result, 'Room stopped'),
                      message='Stopping room…')

    @staticmethod
    def item_name(item):
        return item.get('name', item.get('id', 'Unnamed')) if isinstance(item, dict) else str(item)

    @staticmethod
    def activity(value):
        if not value: return 'stopped'
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            if not value.get('running', value.get('active', True)): return 'stopped'
            return str(value.get('name') or value.get('title') or value.get('status') or 'open')
        return str(value)

    def render_sources(self):
        child = self.source_list.get_first_child()
        while child:
            nxt = child.get_next_sibling(); self.source_list.remove(child); child = nxt
        query = self.search.get_text().casefold().strip()
        categories = ['All', 'Favorites', 'Focus', 'World', 'Nightcore', 'Electro swing', 'Atompunk', 'Finnish', 'Dark academia', 'Apps']
        category = categories[min(self.filter.get_selected(), len(categories)-1)]
        favs = {x.get('url') for x in self.snapshot.get('favorites', []) if isinstance(x, dict)}
        items = self.search_results + (self.snapshot.get('sources') or [])
        items = sorted(items, key=lambda x: (0 if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get('kind') == 'radio' and x.get('url') in favs else 1 if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get('kind') == 'radio' else 2))
        section = None
        seen = set()
        count = 0
        for item in items:
            if not isinstance(item, dict): continue
            key = item.get('url') or item.get('id')
            if key in seen: continue
            seen.add(key)
            haystack = ' '.join(str(item.get(k, '')) for k in ('name', 'group', 'description')) + ' ' + ' '.join(item.get('tags') or [])
            lower = haystack.casefold()
            if query and query not in lower: continue
            if category == 'Favorites' and item.get('url') not in favs: continue
            if category not in ('All', 'Favorites') and category.casefold() not in lower: continue
            group = ('Your favorites' if item.get('url') in favs else 'Explore radio') if item.get('kind') == 'radio' else 'Open elsewhere'
            if group != section:
                self.source_list.append(label(group, 'section-title'))
                section = group
            row = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=10)
            row.add_css_class('source-row')
            body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=2)
            body.set_hexpand(True)
            name = label(item.get('name', 'Unnamed source'), 'source-name')
            name.set_ellipsize(3)
            name.set_max_width_chars(55)
            body.append(name)
            detail = label(item.get('group', ''), 'muted')
            body.append(detail)
            row.append(body)
            if item.get('kind') == 'radio':
                is_fav = item.get('url') in favs
                favorite = button('★' if is_fav else '☆', lambda _, x=item, saved=is_fav: self.favorite(x, saved), 'Remove from favorites' if is_fav else 'Save to favorites')
                row.append(favorite)
            if item.get('kind') == 'radio':
                row.append(button('Tune in', lambda _, x=item: self.tune_source(x)))
                row.append(button('Save station', lambda _, x=item: self.station_panel.save_source(x)))
            else:
                row.append(button('Open elsewhere', lambda _, x=item: self.open_source(x)))
            if item.get('kind') == 'radio' and hub.valid_url(item.get('website')):
                row.append(button('Website', lambda _, x=item: self.open_source(dict(x, kind='web', url=x['website'])), 'Open the station website if its direct stream is unavailable'))
            self.source_list.append(row)
            count += 1
        if not count:
            self.source_list.append(label('No sources match. Try another search or category.', 'muted'))

    def world_search(self):
        query = self.search.get_text().strip()
        if not query:
            self.set_message('Enter a station name, country:FI, tag:genre or language:name.', True)
            return
        self.search_world(query)

    def search_world(self, query):
        def complete(results):
            self.search_results = results
            self.search.set_text('')
            self.filter.set_selected(0)
            self.render_sources()
            self.set_message(f'Found {len(results)} stations')
        self.run_task(lambda: hub.search_radio(query), success=complete, message='Searching world radio…')

    def pause_preference(self, checkbox):
        if self.updating: return
        value = checkbox.get_active()
        self.run_task(lambda: hub.update_state(pause_others_on_radio_start=value), message='Updating preference…')

    def save_named(self, kind):
        name = self.save_name.get_text().strip()
        if not name:
            self.set_message('Enter a name first.', True)
            return
        action = hub.save_profile if kind == 'profile' else hub.save_scene
        self.run_task(lambda: action(name), message='Saving ' + kind + '…')

    def favorite(self, item, saved):
        def change():
            if saved:
                hub.save_json(hub.STATE / 'favorites.json', [x for x in hub.favorites() if x['url'] != item.get('url')])
            else:
                hub.save_favorite(item)
        self.run_task(change, message='Updating favorites…')

    def open_source(self, item):
        if hasattr(self, 'experience') and item.get('kind') == 'radio':
            self.experience.command('music', {'item': item})
            return
        if item.get('kind') == 'search':
            query = item.get('query', '')
            self.search_world(query)
        else:
            self.run_task(lambda: hub.play(item), message='Opening ' + item.get('name', 'source') + '…')

    def tune_source(self, item):
        if self.destination.get_selected() == 1:
            self.background_source(item)
        else:
            self.open_source(item)

    def background_source(self, item):
        self.experience.command('atmosphere', {'kind': 'radio', 'source_id': item.get('id'),
                                               'url': item.get('url'), 'name': item.get('name')})

    def play_online_item(self, item):
        if item.get('provider') == 'music_assistant' and self.destination.get_selected() == 1:
            self.set_message('Music Assistant plays on its selected remote speaker; choose Main audio for this source.', True)
            return False
        if item.get('provider') == 'jellyfin' and self.destination.get_selected() == 1:
            self.experience.command('atmosphere', {'kind': 'radio', 'reference': item, 'name': item.get('name')})
            return True
        if item.get('provider') == 'link':
            self.experience.command('link', {'url': item['url'], 'destination': item.get('route', 'music')}, show_inside=item.get('route', 'music') == 'music')
        else:
            self.experience.command('online', {'service': item.get('provider', 'jellyfin'), 'item': item}, show_inside=True)
        return True

    def choose_player(self, *_):
        if self.updating: return
        i = self.player.get_selected()
        if i < len(self.player_ids):
            player_id = self.player_ids[i]
            self.run_task(lambda: hub.update_state(selected=player_id), message='Selecting player…')

    def visible_player_id(self):
        index = self.player.get_selected()
        return self.player_ids[index] if index < len(self.player_ids) else None

    def transport(self, command):
        player_id = self.visible_player_id()
        if player_id:
            self.run_task(lambda: hub.transport(player_id, command), message='Sending control…')

    def volume_control(self, parent, title, master):
        box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=5)
        box.set_hexpand(True)
        box.append(label(title, 'muted'))
        scale = Gtk.Scale.new_with_range(Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, 0, 100, 1)
        scale.set_hexpand(True); scale.set_draw_value(True)
        scale.connect('value-changed', self.volume_changed, master)
        box.append(scale)
        mute = button('Mute', lambda _: self.mute_player(master))
        if master: self.master_mute = mute
        box.append(mute)
        parent.append(box)
        return scale

    def mute_player(self, master):
        player_id = None if master else self.visible_player_id()
        if not master and not player_id:
            self.set_message('Select a player first.', True)
            return
        self.run_task(lambda: hub.mute(master=master, target_id=player_id), message='Changing mute…')

    def set_scale(self, scale, value, master):
        scale.set_sensitive(value is not None)
        if value is not None and master not in self.scale_editing:
            scale.set_value(float(value))

    def volume_changed(self, scale, master):
        if self.updating: return
        player_id = None if master else self.visible_player_id()
        if not master and not player_id:
            return
        value = round(scale.get_value())
        self.scale_editing.add(master)
        if master in self.scale_timers: GLib.source_remove(self.scale_timers[master])
        def send():
            self.scale_timers.pop(master, None)
            def finish(_):
                self.scale_editing.discard(master)
                self.set_message('Volume changed')
            self.run_task(lambda: hub.set_volume(value, master=master, target_id=player_id), success=finish, message='Changing volume…')
            return False
        self.scale_timers[master] = GLib.timeout_add(350, send)

    def video_volume_changed(self, scale):
        if self.updating: return
        key = 'video'
        self.scale_editing.add(key)
        if key in self.scale_timers: GLib.source_remove(self.scale_timers[key])
        def send():
            self.scale_timers.pop(key, None)
            value = round(scale.get_value())
            def finish(_):
                self.scale_editing.discard(key)
                self.set_message('Video volume changed')
            self.run_task(lambda: ambience.control('volume', 'video', value), success=finish, message='Changing video volume…')
            return False
        self.scale_timers[key] = GLib.timeout_add(350, send)

    def start_vista(self):
        i = self.vista.get_selected()
        if i < len(self.presets):
            preset = self.presets[i]
            if self.experience.snapshot.get('active'):
                self.experience.command('picture', {'action':'select','preset_id':preset['id'],'enabled':True,'still':False,'placement':'9'})
            else:
                self.run_task(lambda: ambience.start(preset, mode='ambience', placement='9'), message='Opening silent vista…')

    def start_url(self, mode):
        url = self.video_url.get_text().strip()
        if not url:
            self.set_message('Enter a YouTube or video URL first.', True); return
        if mode == 'ambience':
            self.experience.command('link', {'url':url,'destination':'picture'})
            return
        def start():
            ambience.start(url, mode=mode, placement='9')
            if mode == 'video':
                hub.update_state(selected='video')
        self.run_task(start, message='Opening video…')

    def start_audio_url(self):
        url = self.video_url.get_text().strip()
        if not url:
            self.set_message('Paste a public YouTube video URL first.', True)
            return
        self.experience.command('link', {'url':url,'destination':'music'})

    def ambience_action(self, kind, action, mode):
        if mode == 'ambience':
            if kind == 'place': self.experience.command('picture', {'action':'place','placement':action})
            else: self.experience.command('layer', {'layer':'picture','action':action})
            return
        self.run_task(lambda: getattr(ambience, kind)(action, mode), message='Updating ' + mode + '…')

    def apply_profile(self):
        i = self.profile.get_selected()
        if i < len(self.profile_items):
            item = self.profile_items[i]
            self.run_task(lambda: hub.restore_profile(item.get('id') if isinstance(item, dict) else item), message='Applying settings profile…')

    def restore_profile(self):
        self.run_task(lambda: hub.restore_profile('default'), message='Restoring default settings…')

    def start_scene(self):
        i = self.scene.get_selected()
        if i < len(self.scene_items):
            item = self.scene_items[i]
            self.run_task(lambda: hub.play_scene(item.get('id') if isinstance(item, dict) else item), message='Starting scene…')


def launch_arguments(arguments):
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Your desktop listening room')
    parser.add_argument('--desk', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--inside', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--preview-link')
    parser.add_argument('--ui', choices=('classic', 'next'), default='classic')
    parser.add_argument('uri', nargs='?')
    args = parser.parse_args(arguments)
    link = args.preview_link
    if args.uri:
        import urllib.parse
        uri = urllib.parse.urlsplit(args.uri)
        if uri.scheme == 'listening-room' and uri.netloc == 'open':
            link = urllib.parse.parse_qs(uri.query).get('url', [''])[0]
        else:
            link = args.uri
    mode = 'desk' if args.desk else 'inside' if args.inside else 'browse'
    return mode, link


def ui_choice(arguments):
    import argparse
    chooser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    chooser.add_argument('--ui', choices=('classic', 'next'), default='classic')
    return chooser.parse_known_args(arguments)[0].ui


def main():
    # Today's window stays the default; the libadwaita window is opt-in.
    if ui_choice(sys.argv[1:]) == 'next':
        import next_window
        return next_window.run([sys.argv[0]])
    return Room().run(sys.argv)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
"""The quiet room surface and permanent three-layer mixer for native GTK."""
import concurrent.futures
from pathlib import Path
import re
import urllib.parse

from gi.repository import Gtk, Gdk, GLib
import session_client
import audio_layers
import audio_devices
import room_discovery


def label(value='', css=None):
    widget = Gtk.Label(label=value, xalign=0)
    widget.set_wrap(True)
    if css:
        widget.add_css_class(css)
    return widget


def button(title, callback, tip=None):
    widget = Gtk.Button(label=title)
    widget.connect('clicked', lambda *_: callback())
    if tip:
        widget.set_tooltip_text(tip)
    return widget


def row(*children, spacing=8):
    box = Gtk.Box(spacing=spacing)
    for child in children:
        box.append(child)
    return box

        self.link = Gtk.Entry()
        self.link.set_placeholder_text('Paste a public radio, YouTube, Twitch or library link')
        self.link.connect('changed', lambda *_: self.preview_link())
        links.append(self.link)

        links.append(self.link_note)
        self.link_music = button('Main audio', lambda: self.play_link('music'))
        self.link_background = button('Background audio', lambda: self.play_link('atmosphere'))
        self.link_picture = button('Send to Picture', lambda: self.play_link('picture'))
        links.append(row(self.link_music, self.link_background, self.link_picture, button('Open elsewhere', self.open_original)))

        notebook.append_page(button('Open links in Listen', lambda: self.app.show_links()), Gtk.Label(label='Find & links'))
