        target.connect('drop', self.drop_link)
        app.window.add_controller(target)
        self.refresh_outputs()
        self.refresh()
        self.poll_timer = GLib.timeout_add(900, self.refresh)

    def command(self, action, args=None, show_inside=False, after=None):
        if self.closed:
            return
        def done(result):
            if show_inside:
                self.show('inside')
            if after:
                after(result)
            self.refresh()
        urgent = action in ('quiet', 'stop', 'leave') or (action == 'layer' and (args or {}).get('action') in ('stop', 'pause'))
        self.app.run_task(lambda: session_client.request(action, args or {}, timeout=5), success=done,
                          message={'enter': 'Entering room…', 'return': 'Returning to your room…', 'save': 'Saving room…'}.get(action), executor=self.interrupts if urgent else self.controls)

    def enter(self, room_id, with_view=True, still=False):
        still = still or bool((self.snapshot.get('settings') or {}).get('reduced_motion'))
        self.command('enter', {'room_id': room_id, 'with_view': with_view, 'still': still}, show_inside=True)

    def enter_saved(self):
        index = self.saved.get_selected()
        if index < len(self.variant_items):
            self.command('enter', {'variant_id': self.variant_items[index]['id']}, show_inside=True)

    def save(self):
        name = self.name.get_text().strip()
        if not name:
            self.app.set_message('Give this room a name before saving.', True)
            self.name.grab_focus()
            return
        pending = list(self.timers)
        for key in pending:
            GLib.source_remove(self.timers.pop(key))
        values = [(layer, action, self.pending_values.pop((layer, action))) for layer, action in pending]
        def save_mix():
            for layer, action, value in values:
                session_client.request('layer', {'layer': layer, 'action': action, 'value': value})
            return session_client.request('save', {'name': name})
        self.app.run_task(save_mix, success=lambda _: self.refresh(), message='Saving room…', executor=self.controls)

    def layer(self, layer, action, value=None):
        args = {'layer': layer, 'action': action}
        if value is not None:
            args['value'] = value
        self.command('layer', args)

    def slider(self, layer, action, value):
        if self.updating or self.closed:
            return
        key = (layer, action)
        self.pending_values[key] = value
        if key in self.timers:
            GLib.source_remove(self.timers[key])
        def send():
            self.timers.pop(key, None)
            self.pending_values.pop(key, None)
            self.layer(layer, action, round(value, 1))
            return False
        self.timers[key] = GLib.timeout_add(160, send)

    def setting(self, key, value):
        if key == 'reduced_motion' and value:
            self.app.still_view.set_active(True)
        self.command('settings', {'values': {key: value}})

    def select_atmosphere(self):
        index = self.atmosphere.get_selected()
        if index and index <= len(self.atmospheres):
            self.command('atmosphere', {'kind': 'local', 'id': self.atmospheres[index-1]['id']})

    def refresh(self):
        if self.closed:
            return False
        if self.pending:
            return True
        self.pending = True
        future = self.executor.submit(session_client.request, 'inspect', {}, 3)
        def done(f):
            try:
                value = f.result()
                GLib.idle_add(self.render, value)
            except Exception as error:
                GLib.idle_add(self.failed, str(error))
        future.add_done_callback(done)
        return True

    def failed(self, error):
        self.pending = False
        if not self.closed:
            self.active_label.set_text('Room controller unavailable · ' + error)
        return False

    def render(self, snapshot):
        self.pending = False
        if self.closed:
            return False
        self.snapshot = snapshot
        if hasattr(self.app, 'station_panel'):
            self.app.station_panel.render(snapshot)
        self.updating = True
        active = snapshot.get('active') or {}
        last = snapshot.get('last_session') or {}
        settings = snapshot.get('settings') or {}
        preferred = settings.get('preferred_output')
        if preferred != getattr(self, 'last_output_pref', object()):
            self.output.set_selected(next((i+1 for i,item in enumerate(self.output_items) if item['name'] == preferred), 0))
            self.last_output_pref = preferred
        name = active.get('name') or 'Listening room'
        station = snapshot.get('station') or {}
        track = (station.get('current') or {}).get('name')
        playing = (station.get('definition') or {}).get('name') or name
        if track: playing += ' · ' + track
        self.active_label.set_text(('Currently playing: ' + playing) if active else ('Return available: ' + last['name'] if last.get('name') else 'Choose a room to begin'))
        queue = (active.get('music') or {}).get('queue') or []
        index = (active.get('music') or {}).get('queue_index', 0)
        self.previous_button.set_sensitive(bool(queue) and index > 0)
        self.next_button.set_sensitive(bool(queue) and index+1 < len(queue))
        self.inside_title.set_text(name)
        self.desk_title.set_text(name)
        self.save_button.set_sensitive(bool(active) and (snapshot.get('transition') or {}).get('kind') != 'enter')
        self.return_button.set_sensitive(bool(last))
        self.inside_button.set_sensitive(bool(active))
        self.desk_button.set_sensitive(bool(active))
        poster = active.get('poster_path')
        if poster and Path(poster).is_file():
            self.art.set_filename(poster)
        else:
            self.art.set_filename(None)
        self.theme(active)
        layers = snapshot.get('layers') or {}
        pieces = []
        for kind in ('music', 'atmosphere'):
            state = layers.get(kind) or {}
            recipe = active.get(kind) or {}
            title = state.get('name') or state.get('title') or recipe.get('name') or recipe.get('id') or recipe.get('source_id') or 'Not selected'
            status = state.get('status', 'Stopped')
            self.layer_labels[kind].set_text(title + ' · ' + status)
            if status.lower() == 'playing':
                pieces.append(title)
            key = (kind, 'volume')
            if key not in self.timers:
                level = state.get('volume', recipe.get('volume', 20 if kind == 'atmosphere' else 50))
                if isinstance(level, (int, float)):
                    self.scales[kind].set_value(level)
                    if kind == 'music': self.desk_scale.set_value(level)
            self.mute_buttons[kind].set_label('Unmute' if state.get('muted', recipe.get('muted', False)) else 'Mute')
        music_state = layers.get('music') or {}
        self.desk_track.set_text(music_state.get('title') or (active.get('music') or {}).get('name') or '')
        self.mix_description.set_text(' + '.join(pieces) or 'The room is quiet.')
        picture = layers.get('picture') or {}
        recipe = active.get('picture') or {}
        self.picture_label.set_text((picture.get('name') or 'Open') if picture.get('status') not in ('Stopped', None) else 'Closed')
        atmosphere_state = layers.get('atmosphere') or {}
        self.background_next.set_sensitive(bool(atmosphere_state.get('can_next')))
        self.openness.set_sensitive(atmosphere_state.get('kind') == 'local' and bool(atmosphere_state.get('outdoor')))
        if not hasattr(self, 'applied_defaults'):
            self.app.still_view.set_active(bool(settings.get('still') or settings.get('reduced_motion')))
            self.applied_defaults = True
        self.motion.set_active(bool(recipe.get('still', settings.get('reduced_motion', False))))
        place = recipe.get('placement', settings.get('placement', '9'))
        self.placement.set_selected(['9', 'here', 'pin', 'pip'].index(place) if place in ('9', 'here', 'pin', 'pip') else 0)
        default_place = settings.get('placement', '9')
        self.default_place.set_selected(['9', 'here', 'pin', 'pip'].index(default_place) if default_place in ('9', 'here', 'pin', 'pip') else 0)
        if ('atmosphere', 'window') not in self.timers:
            self.openness.set_value((active.get('atmosphere') or {}).get('window_open', 35))
        self.disconnect.set_active(bool(settings.get('pause_on_disconnect', True)))
        self.calls.set_active(bool(settings.get('duck_on_call', False)))
        self.reduced.set_active(bool(settings.get('reduced_motion', False)))
        self.resume_button.set_visible(bool(snapshot.get('resume_offer')))
        variants = snapshot.get('variants') or []
        if variants != self.variant_items:
            self.variant_items = variants
            self.saved.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new([item['name'] for item in variants] or ['Save a room to keep its complete mix']))
            self.saved_button.set_sensitive(bool(variants))
        extra_errors = [str(value) for key, value in (snapshot.get('errors') or {}).items() if key not in self.errors]
        transition = snapshot.get('transition') or {}
        if extra_errors: self.app.set_message('; '.join(extra_errors), True)
        elif transition.get('kind') == 'enter': self.app.set_message('Entering ' + transition.get('name', 'room') + '…')
        elif self.app.message.get_text().startswith(('Entering', 'Saving', 'Returning', 'Opening')):
            self.app.set_message(('Current room: ' + name) if active else 'Choose a room to begin')
        for kind, widget in self.errors.items():
            error = (snapshot.get('errors') or {}).get(kind)
            warning = (layers.get(kind) or {}).get('warning')
            widget.set_text('; '.join(str(value) for value in (error, warning) if value))
            widget.set_visible(bool(error or warning))
        if not active and self.was_active and self.mode != 'browse':
            self.show('browse')
        marker = (active.get('id'), active.get('name'))
        if active and marker != getattr(self, 'last_room_marker', None):
            self.app.set_message('Current room: ' + name)
        self.last_room_marker = marker
        self.was_active = bool(active)
        if hasattr(self.app, 'connections'):
            self.app.connections.update_queue({'items': (active.get('music') or {}).get('queue') or [], 'index': (active.get('music') or {}).get('queue_index', 0)})
        self.updating = False
        return False

    def theme(self, active):
        accent = active.get('accent', '#c79b68')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}', str(accent)):
            accent = '#c79b68'
        # Use a restrained tint of the authored room's accent with readable text.
        rgb = [int(accent[i:i+2], 16) for i in (1, 3, 5)]
        base = '#'+''.join(f'{int(c*.075+17):02x}' for c in rgb)
        panel = '#'+''.join(f'{int(c*.12+25):02x}' for c in rgb)
        css = f'notebook > stack, notebook > header, viewport, list {{ background-color: {base}; color: #e7edf3; }} notebook > header {{ background-color: {panel}; }} notebook tab {{ color: #bdc9d2; }} notebook tab:checked {{ background-color: {base}; color: #ffffff; }} popover contents {{ background-color: {panel}; color: #e7edf3; }} button:disabled {{ opacity: .45; }} button, dropdown {{ background-image: none; background-color: {panel}; color: #e7edf3; border: 1px solid #53606b; }} entry, text {{ background-color: {base}; color: #e7edf3; }} scale highlight {{ background-color: {accent}; }} window {{ background: {base}; }} .room-mixer {{ background: {panel}; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; }} .inside-title {{ color: {accent}; font-family: serif; font-size: 29px; }} .desk-title {{ color: {accent}; font-size: 22px; }} .layer-title {{ font-weight: 700; }} .session-caption {{ color: #d4dce3; }}'
        self.app.session_colors.load_from_data(css.encode())

    def browser_page_changed(self):
        visible = self.mode == 'browse' and self.app.notebook.get_current_page() == 0
        self.saved_row.set_visible(visible)
        self.discovery_box.set_visible(visible)

    def show(self, mode):
        self.mode = mode
        self.stack.set_visible_child_name(mode)
        self.browser_page_changed()
        self.options.set_visible(mode != 'desk')
        self.mixer.set_visible(mode != 'desk')
        self.other_players.set_visible(mode != 'desk')
        if mode == 'desk':
            self.app.window.set_size_request(500, 230)
            self.app.window.set_default_size(640, 300)
        else:
            self.app.window.set_size_request(760, 650)
            self.app.window.set_default_size(1060, 900)

    def refresh_outputs(self):
        def get():
            import ambience
            return audio_devices.outputs(), ambience.monitors()
        def apply(value):
            if self.closed: return
            self.output_items, self.displays = value
            self.output.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new(['System output'] + [item.get('description') or item.get('name', 'Output') for item in self.output_items]))
            preferred = (self.snapshot.get('settings') or {}).get('preferred_output')
            self.output.set_selected(next((i+1 for i,item in enumerate(self.output_items) if item['name'] == preferred), 0))
            self.updating = True
            self.display.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new(['Follow placement'] + [item.get('description') or item['name'] for item in self.displays]))
            wanted = (self.snapshot.get('settings') or {}).get('display')
            self.display.set_selected(next((i+1 for i,item in enumerate(self.displays) if item['name'] == wanted), 0))
            self.updating = False
        self.app.run_task(get, success=apply, executor=self.executor)

    def selected_output(self):
        index = self.output.get_selected()
        return self.output_items[index-1]['name'] if index and index <= len(self.output_items) else None

    def select_output(self):
        name = self.selected_output()
        self.command('settings', {'values': {'preferred_output': name}})
        if name:
            self.app.set_message('Preferred output saved; room audio follows this output.')

    def test_output(self):
        name = self.selected_output()
        self.app.run_task(lambda: audio_devices.test_sound(name), executor=self.executor, message='Playing a quiet test sound…')

    def preference(self):
        return ['any', 'instrumental', 'speech', 'low-energy', 'familiar', 'explore'][self.discovery.get_selected()]

    def recent(self):
        recent = self.snapshot.get('recent') or []
        return [item.get('room_id') or item.get('id') if isinstance(item, dict) else item for item in recent]

    def filter_rooms(self):
        self.app.room_fingerprint = None
        self.app.render_rooms(self.app.snapshot.get('rooms') or [])

    def surprise(self):
        chosen, reason = room_discovery.choose(self.app.snapshot.get('rooms') or [], self.preference(), self.recent(), self.app.preview_room_id)
        self.discovery_note.set_text(reason)
        self.app.set_message(reason, not bool(chosen))
        if chosen:
            self.app.preview_room_action(None, GLib.Variant('s', chosen['id']))

    def drop_link(self, _target, value, _x, _y):
        self.link.set_text(value.strip())
        self.show('browse')
        self.app.show_links()
        return True

    def preview_link(self):
        import online_services
        try:
            preview = online_services.preview_link(self.link.get_text().strip())
            self.link_note.set_text(preview['name'] + '. Choose an available destination to start.')
            actions = preview['actions']
        except ValueError as error:
            self.link_note.set_text(str(error))
            actions = []
        self.link_music.set_sensitive('music' in actions)
        self.link_background.set_sensitive('atmosphere' in actions)
        self.link_background.set_tooltip_text(None if 'atmosphere' in actions else 'This link cannot be used as background audio.')
        self.link_picture.set_sensitive('picture' in actions)
        self.link_picture.set_tooltip_text(None if 'picture' in actions else 'This link does not provide a picture.')

    def play_link(self, destination):
        url = self.link.get_text().strip()
        self.command('link', {'url': url, 'destination': destination}, show_inside=destination == 'music')

    def open_original(self):
        import listening_hub as hub
        url = self.link.get_text().strip()
        if hub.valid_url(url):
            self.app.run_task(lambda: hub.run(['xdg-open', url]), executor=self.executor)

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True
        GLib.source_remove(self.poll_timer)
        for timer in self.timers.values():
            GLib.source_remove(timer)
        self.timers.clear()
        self.executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
        self.controls.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
        self.interrupts.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
"""GTK connection setup and on-demand library/remote discovery.

Constructing this panel never sends network requests or starts playback.
All playback goes through the application's shared-session callback.
"""
import concurrent.futures
import threading

import gi
gi.require_version('Gtk', '4.0')
from gi.repository import Gtk, Gio, GLib, Gdk

import online_services as online
import provider_auth
import twitch_credentials


def text(value='', css='muted'):
    label = Gtk.Label(label=value, xalign=0)
    label.set_wrap(True)
    if css:
        label.add_css_class(css)
    return label


def button(title, callback):
    item = Gtk.Button(label=title)
    item.connect('clicked', lambda *_: callback())
    return item


def entry(placeholder='', value=''):
    item = Gtk.Entry()
    item.set_placeholder_text(placeholder)
    item.set_text(value)
    item.set_hexpand(True)
    return item


def clear(box):
    child = box.get_first_child()
    while child:
        next_child = child.get_next_sibling()
        box.remove(child)
        child = next_child


class ConnectionsPanel(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self, app):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=12)
        self.app = app
        self.closed = False
        self.executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3, thread_name_prefix='room-connections')
        self.cancel = threading.Event()
        self.library_generation = 0
        self.ma_generation = 0
        self.art_generation = 0
        self.library_items = []
        self.selected = None
        self.players = []
        self.ma_items = []
        self.scenes = []
        self.settings_widgets = {}
        self.set_margin_top(12)
        self.set_margin_bottom(12)
        self.set_margin_start(14)
        self.set_margin_end(14)
        self.append(text('Your music and connected rooms', 'section-title'))
        self.append(text('Browse when you choose. Playback stays in the current listening session.'))

        self._build_library()
        self._build_link_input()
        self._build_remote()
        self._build_lighting()
        self._build_remembered()
        self._build_phone()
        self._build_settings()
        self._build_twitch_login()
        self.twitch_validation_timer = GLib.timeout_add_seconds(3600, self._validate_twitch_session)
        GLib.idle_add(self._validate_twitch_session_once)

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True
        if self.twitch_login is not None:
            self.twitch_login.cancel()
        GLib.source_remove(self.twitch_validation_timer)
        self.cancel.set()
        self.executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)

    def _run(self, func, success, notice, message, valid=None):
        if self.closed:
            return
        notice.set_text(message)
        notice.remove_css_class('error')
        future = self.executor.submit(func)
        def complete(work):
            try:
                result, error = work.result(), None
            except Exception as exc:
                result, error = None, str(exc) if isinstance(exc, online.ConnectionError) else 'This operation failed. Check the connection and retry.'
            def finish():
                if self.closed or (valid is not None and not valid()):
                    return False
                if error:
                    notice.set_text(error)
                    notice.add_css_class('error')
                else:
                    success(result)
                return False
            GLib.idle_add(finish)
        future.add_done_callback(complete)

    def _section(self, title, expanded=False):
        expander = Gtk.Expander(label=title)
        expander.set_expanded(expanded)
        body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=8)
        body.set_margin_top(8)
        body.set_margin_bottom(10)
        expander.set_child(body)
        self.append(expander)
        return body

    def _build_library(self):
        body = self._section('Jellyfin library', True)
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.library_kind = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Albums', 'Playlists', 'Recently added albums', 'Tracks'])
        self.library_query = entry('Search your music library')
        self.library_query.connect('activate', lambda *_: self.search_library())
        row.append(self.library_kind)
        row.append(self.library_query)
        row.append(button('Browse', self.search_library))
        body.append(row)
        self.library_notice = text('Connect Jellyfin below, then browse albums, playlists or tracks.')
        body.append(self.library_notice)
        split = Gtk.Box(spacing=12)
        self.artwork = Gtk.Picture()
        self.artwork.set_content_fit(Gtk.ContentFit.CONTAIN)
        self.artwork.set_size_request(130, 130)
        self.artwork.set_visible(False)
        split.append(self.artwork)
        self.library_list = Gtk.ListBox()
        self.library_list.set_selection_mode(Gtk.SelectionMode.SINGLE)
        self.library_list.connect('row-selected', self.select_library)
        scroller = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        scroller.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.NEVER, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
        scroller.set_min_content_height(140)
        scroller.set_max_content_height(240)
        scroller.set_propagate_natural_height(True)
        scroller.set_hexpand(True)
        scroller.set_child(self.library_list)
        split.append(scroller)
        body.append(split)
        self.library_preview = text('Select an item to see its actions.')
        body.append(self.library_preview)
        actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.library_play = button('Play selected', self.play_library)
        self.library_play.add_css_class('suggested-action')
        self.library_tracks = button('Show tracks', self.show_tracks)
        self.library_open = button('Open in Jellyfin', self.open_library)
        self.library_station = button('Save station', self.save_library_station)
        self.library_next = button('Play next', self.library_play_next)
        for item in (self.library_play, self.library_tracks, self.library_open, self.library_station, self.library_next):
            item.set_sensitive(False)
            actions.append(item)
        body.append(actions)
        self.queue_label = text('Albums and playlists start at their first track. Lists are bounded to keep browsing responsive.')
        body.append(self.queue_label)
        self.queue_list = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=3)
        queue_expander = Gtk.Expander(label='Prepared library queue')
        queue_expander.set_child(self.queue_list)
        body.append(queue_expander)

    def search_library(self):
        self.library_generation += 1
        generation = self.library_generation
        kind = ['albums', 'playlists', 'recent', 'tracks'][self.library_kind.get_selected()]
        query = self.library_query.get_text()
        self._run(lambda: online.browse_jellyfin(query, kind, cancel_event=self.cancel),
                  lambda rows: self._library_result(generation, rows), self.library_notice, 'Browsing Jellyfin…',
                  valid=lambda: generation == self.library_generation)

    def _library_result(self, generation, rows):
        if generation != self.library_generation:
            return
        self.library_items = rows
        self.selected = None
        clear(self.library_list)
        for item in rows:
            row = Gtk.ListBoxRow()
            row.item = item
            box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=2)
            box.set_margin_top(5)
            box.set_margin_bottom(5)
            box.append(text(item['name'], 'source-name'))
            box.append(text(item.get('artist') or item.get('type', 'Music')))
            row.set_child(box)
            self.library_list.append(row)
        for action in (self.library_play, self.library_tracks, self.library_open, self.library_station, self.library_next):
            action.set_sensitive(False)
        self.artwork.set_visible(False)
        self.library_notice.set_text(str(len(rows)) + ' items shown.' if rows else 'No matching music found. Try another search or library view.')

    def select_library(self, _list, row):
        self.art_generation += 1
        generation = self.art_generation
        self.selected = row.item if row else None
        self.library_play.set_sensitive(self.selected is not None)
        self.library_open.set_sensitive(self.selected is not None)
        self.library_station.set_sensitive(self.selected is not None)
        self.library_next.set_sensitive(bool(self.selected and self.selected.get('type') == 'Audio'))
        self.library_tracks.set_sensitive(bool(self.selected and self.selected.get('type') in ('MusicAlbum', 'Playlist')))
        self.artwork.set_visible(False)
        if not self.selected:
            return
        item = dict(self.selected)
        self.library_preview.set_text(item['name'] + ('\n' + item['artist'] if item.get('artist') else ''))
        def fetch_art():
            try:
                return online.artwork(item)
            except online.ConnectionError:
                return None
        def show_art(path):
            if path:
                self.artwork.set_filename(path)
                self.artwork.set_visible(True)
            self.library_notice.set_text('Selected. Choose Play or Show tracks.' if path else 'Artwork unavailable. Playback remains available.')
        self._run(fetch_art, show_art, self.library_notice, 'Selected. Loading artwork…', valid=lambda: generation == self.art_generation)

    def save_library_station(self):
        if self.selected:
            self.app.station_panel.save_reference(dict(self.selected))

    def library_play_next(self):
        if self.selected and self.selected.get('type') == 'Audio':
            self.app.experience.command('station.play_next', {'item': dict(self.selected)})

    def play_library(self):
        if self.selected:
            self.app.play_online_item(dict(self.selected))
            self.library_notice.set_text('Sent to the listening session. Playback status appears in Music.')

    def show_tracks(self):
        if not self.selected:
            return
        item = dict(self.selected)
        self.library_generation += 1
        generation = self.library_generation
        self._run(lambda: online.jellyfin_queue(item, self.cancel), lambda rows: self._library_result(generation, rows),
                  self.library_notice, 'Loading tracks…', valid=lambda: generation == self.library_generation)

    def open_library(self):
        if self.selected:
            try:
                Gio.AppInfo.launch_default_for_uri(online.jellyfin_link(self.selected), None)
            except (online.ConnectionError, GLib.Error) as exc:
                self.library_notice.set_text(str(exc))

    def update_queue(self, queue=None):
        queue = queue or online.library_queue()
        fingerprint = str(queue)
        if getattr(self, '_queue_fingerprint', None) == fingerprint:
            return
        self._queue_fingerprint = fingerprint
        clear(self.queue_list)
        rows = queue.get('items') or queue.get('queue') or []
        index = queue.get('index', queue.get('queue_index', 0))
        for number, item in enumerate(rows[:200]):
            prefix = 'Playing: ' if number == index else ''
            self.queue_list.append(text(prefix + item.get('name', 'Track')))
        if not rows:
            self.queue_list.append(text('Choose an album or playlist to prepare a queue.'))

    def _build_link_input(self):
        body = self._section('Send a link to this room')
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.link_entry = entry('Paste a public video, channel or audio URL')
        self.link_entry.connect('activate', lambda *_: self.preview_url(self.link_entry.get_text()))
        row.append(self.link_entry)
        row.append(button('Preview link', lambda: self.preview_url(self.link_entry.get_text())))
        body.append(row)
        self.link_notice = text('Paste or drop a link to preview it. Preview never starts playback.')
        body.append(self.link_notice)
        self.link_actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        body.append(self.link_actions)
        drop = Gtk.DropTarget.new(str, Gdk.DragAction.COPY)
        drop.connect('drop', lambda _target, value, _x, _y: self.preview_url(value))
        self.add_controller(drop)

    def preview_url(self, value):
        clear(self.link_actions)
        try:
            item = online.preview_link(value.strip())
        except online.ConnectionError as error:
            self.link_notice.set_text(str(error))
            return False
        self.link_entry.set_text(value)
        self.link_notice.set_text(item['name'] + '\nChoose where to use this link.')
        for action in item['actions']:
            title = {'music': 'Play as Music', 'atmosphere': 'Play as Atmosphere', 'picture': 'Open silent Picture', 'original': 'Open original'}[action]
            def dispatch(route=action, selected=dict(item)):
                if route == 'original':
                    Gio.AppInfo.launch_default_for_uri(selected.get('original') or selected['url'], None)
                else:
                    self.app.play_online_item(dict(selected, provider='link', route=route))
            self.link_actions.append(button(title, dispatch))
        return True

    def _build_remote(self):
        body = self._section('Speakers through Music Assistant')
        body.append(text('Music Assistant controls its selected player. Sending music does not transfer the local atmosphere mix.'))
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.remote_player = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Load players first'])
        self.remote_player.set_hexpand(True)
        self.remote_target = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Transfer destination'])
        row.append(self.remote_player)
        row.append(button('Load players', self.load_players))
        body.append(row)
        media_row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.remote_uri = entry('Supported media URL or Music Assistant URI')
        media_row.append(self.remote_uri)
        media_row.append(button('Play on selected speaker', self.play_remote))
        body.append(media_row)
        transfer_row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        transfer_row.append(self.remote_target)
        transfer_row.append(button('Transfer selected queue', self.transfer_remote))
        body.append(transfer_row)
        self.remote_notice = text('Connect Music Assistant below, then load its available players.')
        body.append(self.remote_notice)
        body.append(text('Browse Music Assistant library or search its configured providers. For YouTube Music, configure its provider in Music Assistant first.'))
        browse = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.ma_kind = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Playlists', 'Tracks', 'Albums'])
        self.ma_query = entry('Music search')
        browse.append(self.ma_kind)
        browse.append(self.ma_query)
        browse.append(button('Browse library', lambda: self.browse_ma(False)))
        browse.append(button('Search providers', lambda: self.browse_ma(True)))
        body.append(browse)
        self.ma_provider = entry('Optional Music Assistant provider ID or domain')
        body.append(self.ma_provider)
        results = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.ma_choice = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Browse music first'])
        self.ma_choice.set_hexpand(True)
        results.append(self.ma_choice)
        results.append(button('Play selected on speaker', self.play_ma_item))
        results.append(button('Start radio mix on speaker', lambda: self.play_ma_item(True)))
        body.append(results)


    def browse_ma(self, search_all):
        self.ma_generation += 1
        generation = self.ma_generation
        self.ma_items = []
        self.ma_choice.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new(['Loading music…']))
        kind = ['playlists', 'tracks', 'albums'][self.ma_kind.get_selected()]
        query = self.ma_query.get_text()
        provider = self.ma_provider.get_text().strip() or None
        def show(rows):
            self.ma_items = rows
            self.ma_choice.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new([row['name'] + (' — ' + row['artist'] if row.get('artist') else '') for row in rows] or ['No music found']))
            self.remote_notice.set_text(str(len(rows)) + ' items returned. Choose an available speaker to play.')
        self._run(lambda: online.browse_music_assistant(query, kind, self.cancel, provider, search_all),
                  show, self.remote_notice, 'Browsing Music Assistant…', valid=lambda: generation == self.ma_generation)

    def play_ma_item(self, radio_mode=False):
        index, player = self.ma_choice.get_selected(), self.remote_player.get_selected()
        if index >= len(self.ma_items) or player >= len(self.players) or not self.players[player]['available']:
            self.remote_notice.set_text('Choose music and an available speaker first.')
            return
        item = dict(self.ma_items[index], player_id=self.players[player]['id'])
        if radio_mode:
            item['radio_mode'] = True
        if self.app.play_online_item(item) is not False:
            self.remote_notice.set_text('Sent to the listening session. The selected speaker reports playback.')

    def load_players(self):
        def show(rows):
            self.players = rows
            labels = [row['name'] + ('' if row['available'] else ' (unavailable)') for row in rows] or ['No players found']
            self.remote_player.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new(labels))
            self.remote_target.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new(labels))
            self.remote_notice.set_text(str(len(rows)) + ' players returned. Select a source and destination explicitly.')
        self._run(lambda: online.ma_players(self.cancel), show, self.remote_notice, 'Loading players…')

    def play_remote(self):
        index = self.remote_player.get_selected()
        if index >= len(self.players) or not self.players[index]['available']:
            self.remote_notice.set_text('Choose an available speaker first.')
            return
        uri = self.remote_uri.get_text().strip()
        if not uri:
            self.remote_notice.set_text('Enter a media URL or URI first.')
            return
        player = self.players[index]
        self.app.play_online_item({'provider': 'music_assistant', 'uri': uri, 'player_id': player['id'], 'name': player['name']})
        self.remote_notice.set_text('Sent to the listening session. Music shows the selected speaker.')

    def transfer_remote(self):
        source, target = self.remote_player.get_selected(), self.remote_target.get_selected()
        if source >= len(self.players) or target >= len(self.players) or source == target:
            self.remote_notice.set_text('Choose two different players before transferring a queue.')
            return
        item = {'provider': 'music_assistant', 'action': 'transfer', 'source_player_id': self.players[source]['id'],
                'player_id': self.players[target]['id'], 'name': self.players[target]['name']}
        self.app.play_online_item(item)
        self.remote_notice.set_text('Queue transfer requested. The destination player reports its playback state.')

    def _build_lighting(self):
        body = self._section('Room lighting through Home Assistant')
        body.append(text('Link a scene explicitly. Entering that room can then apply it; leaving restores a captured lighting state.'))
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        import room_catalogue
        self.room_refs = [{'id': room['id'], 'name': room['name']} for room in room_catalogue.RECIPES]
        self.lighting_room = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings([room['name'] for room in self.room_refs])
        self.lighting_scene = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Load scenes first'])
        self.lighting_scene.set_hexpand(True)
        row.append(self.lighting_room)
        row.append(self.lighting_scene)
        row.append(button('Load scenes', self.load_scenes))
        body.append(row)
        actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        actions.append(button('Link scene to room', self.link_lighting))
        actions.append(button('Remove room lighting link', self.unlink_lighting))
        body.append(actions)
        self.lighting_notice = text('No lighting is changed while browsing or testing connections.')
        body.append(self.lighting_notice)

    def load_scenes(self):
        def show(rows):
            self.scenes = rows
            self.lighting_scene.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new([row['name'] for row in rows] or ['No scenes found']))
            self.lighting_notice.set_text(str(len(rows)) + ' scenes returned. Linking does not activate a scene now.')
        self._run(lambda: online.ha_scenes(self.cancel), show, self.lighting_notice, 'Loading lighting scenes…')

    def link_lighting(self):
        index = self.lighting_scene.get_selected()
        room_index = self.lighting_room.get_selected()
        if index >= len(self.scenes) or room_index >= len(self.room_refs):
            self.lighting_notice.set_text('Choose a room and load its available lighting scenes first.')
            return
        scene, room = self.scenes[index], self.room_refs[room_index]
        if not scene.get('entities'):
            self.lighting_notice.set_text('This scene does not report its affected entities, so the previous lighting cannot be captured. Choose another scene.')
            return
        try:
            online.set_room_scene(room['id'], scene['id'], scene['entities'])
            self.lighting_notice.set_text(scene['name'] + ' will apply when entering ' + room['name'] + '.')
        except online.ConnectionError as error:
            self.lighting_notice.set_text(str(error))

    def unlink_lighting(self):
        room = self.room_refs[self.lighting_room.get_selected()]
        online.set_room_scene(room['id'])
        self.lighting_notice.set_text('Removed the lighting link for ' + room['name'] + '.')

    def _build_remembered(self):
        body = self._section('Remember what you heard')
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.remember_note = entry('Optional note about this moment')
        row.append(self.remember_note)
        row.append(button('Remember playing', self.remember_playing))
        row.append(button('Show remembered', self.show_remembered))
        body.append(row)
        self.remember_notice = text('Bookmarks stay local. Radio metadata is preserved as reported by the player.')
        body.append(self.remember_notice)
        self.remember_list = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=6)
        body.append(self.remember_list)
        actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        actions.append(button('Load ListenBrainz history', self.load_history))
        actions.append(button('Load recommendations', self.load_recommendations))
        body.append(actions)

    def remember_playing(self):
        try:
            experience = getattr(self.app, 'experience', None)
            session = getattr(experience, 'snapshot', {}) or {}
            snapshot = session if session.get('active') else self.app.snapshot
            online.bookmark(snapshot, self.remember_note.get_text())
            self.remember_note.set_text('')
            self.show_remembered()
        except online.ConnectionError as error:
            self.remember_notice.set_text(str(error))

    def show_remembered(self):
        self._show_remembered(online.remembered()[:20])
        self.remember_notice.set_text('Latest local bookmarks. Metadata may describe a station rather than a track.')

    def _show_remembered(self, rows):
        clear(self.remember_list)
        for item in rows:
            box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=3)
            box.append(text(' — '.join(value for value in (item.get('artist'), item.get('title') or item.get('station')) if value), 'source-name'))
            if item.get('note'):
                box.append(text(item['note']))
            links = online.discovery_links(item)
            actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
            actions.append(button('Find in Jellyfin', lambda query=links['query']: self.find_library(query)))
            actions.append(button('Open in YouTube Music', lambda url=links['youtube_music']: Gio.AppInfo.launch_default_for_uri(url, None)))
            box.append(actions)
            self.remember_list.append(box)
        if not rows:
            self.remember_list.append(text('Nothing remembered yet.'))

    def find_library(self, query):
        self.library_kind.set_selected(3)
        self.library_query.set_text(query)
        self.search_library()

    def load_history(self):
        def show(rows):
            projected = [{'artist': str((row.get('track_metadata') or {}).get('artist_name', '')),
                          'title': str((row.get('track_metadata') or {}).get('track_name', ''))} for row in rows if isinstance(row, dict)]
            self._show_remembered(projected)
            self.remember_notice.set_text('Recent ListenBrainz history. Loading history does not submit listens.')
        self._run(online.listenbrainz_history, show, self.remember_notice, 'Loading listening history…')

    def load_recommendations(self):
        def show(rows):
            clear(self.remember_list)
            for item in rows:
                # The recommendation API returns recording identities, not
                # verified display titles; MusicBrainz supplies their details.
                self.remember_list.append(button('Explore recommended recording', lambda url=item['url']: Gio.AppInfo.launch_default_for_uri(url, None)))
            self.remember_notice.set_text(str(len(rows)) + ' recommendations. Open a recording to see its verified details.' if rows else 'No recommendations have been generated for this account yet.')
        self._run(online.listenbrainz_recommendations, show, self.remember_notice, 'Loading recommendations…')

    def _build_settings(self):
        settings = online.config()
        results = online.checks()
        for service, spec in online.SERVICES.items():
            body = self._section('Connect ' + spec['name'])
            values = settings[service]
            endpoint = entry('Server address', values['endpoint'])
            endpoint.set_tooltip_text('Use the final HTTP or HTTPS server address, including any installation subpath.')
            body.append(endpoint)
            if service == 'audiomuse':
                body.append(text('The health test checks the web service only. Generator worker readiness is separate. Previously generated playlists can be browsed in Jellyfin.'))
            if service == 'jellyfin':
                username = entry('Jellyfin username')
                password = Gtk.PasswordEntry()
                password.set_show_peek_icon(True)
                body.append(username)
                body.append(password)
                body.append(button('Sign in to Jellyfin', lambda u=username, p=password: self.jellyfin_sign_in(u, p)))
            token = Gtk.PasswordEntry()
            token.set_tooltip_text('Access token. Leave blank to keep the saved token.')
            body.append(text('Access token (leave blank to keep the saved token)'))
            token.set_show_peek_icon(True)
            body.append(token)
            private_file = entry('Or use an existing private token file', values['token_file'])
            body.append(private_file)
            notice = text(results.get(service, {}).get('detail') or 'Not tested. Supported: ' + ', '.join(spec['capabilities']).replace('_', ' ') + '.')
            body.append(notice)
            actions = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
            actions.append(button('Save connection', lambda key=service: self.save_settings(key)))
            actions.append(button('Test connection', lambda key=service: self.test_settings(key)))
            body.append(actions)
            self.settings_widgets[service] = {'endpoint': endpoint, 'token': token, 'token_file': private_file, 'notice': notice}
            body.append(text('Tokens are stored privately, separately from room presets. Environment-provided service tokens take precedence.'))

    def jellyfin_sign_in(self, username, password):
        fields = self.settings_widgets['jellyfin']
        if not self.save_settings('jellyfin'):
            return
        user, secret = username.get_text(), password.get_text()
        password.set_text('')
        def done(_result):
            fields['token_file'].set_text(online.config()['jellyfin']['token_file'])
            fields['notice'].set_text('Signed in. Test the connection to verify library access.')
        self._run(lambda: online.jellyfin_login(user, secret, self.cancel), done,
                  fields['notice'], 'Signing in to Jellyfin…')

    def _build_twitch_login(self):
        body = self._section('Connect Twitch')
        body.append(text('A saved Twitch CLI login is reused automatically. To connect an app account, enter its Twitch client ID and authorize this device.'))
        self.twitch_client = entry('Twitch application client ID')
        body.append(self.twitch_client)
        self.twitch_notice = text('No authorization has been started.')
        body.append(self.twitch_notice)
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        row.append(button('Begin Twitch sign-in', self.twitch_begin))
        row.append(button('Finish Twitch sign-in', self.twitch_finish))
        body.append(row)
        self.twitch_login = None

    def twitch_begin(self):
        try:
            login = provider_auth.TwitchDeviceLogin(self.twitch_client.get_text().strip())
        except provider_auth.AuthError as error:
            self.twitch_notice.set_text(str(error))
            return
        if self.twitch_login is not None:
            self.twitch_login.cancel()
        self.twitch_login = login
        def begin():
            try:
                return login.begin()
            except provider_auth.AuthError as error:
                raise online.ConnectionError(str(error)) from None
        def show(result):
            self.twitch_notice.set_text('Enter code ' + result['code'] + ' on Twitch, then choose Finish Twitch sign-in.')
            try:
                Gio.AppInfo.launch_default_for_uri(result['url'], None)
            except GLib.Error:
                self.twitch_notice.set_text('Open https://www.twitch.tv/activate and enter code ' + result['code'] + ', then finish sign-in.')
        self._run(begin, show, self.twitch_notice, 'Starting Twitch sign-in…', valid=lambda: self.twitch_login is login)

    def twitch_finish(self):
        login = self.twitch_login
        if login is None:
            self.twitch_notice.set_text('Begin Twitch sign-in first.')
            return
        def finish():
            try:
                return login.finish()
            except provider_auth.AuthError as error:
                raise online.ConnectionError(str(error)) from None
        def show(result):
            self.twitch_notice.set_text('Connected. Twitch discovery can now use this account.' if result.get('connected') else 'Waiting for Twitch approval. Approve in your browser, then choose Finish again.')
            if result.get('connected'):
                self.twitch_login = None
                GLib.idle_add(self._validate_twitch_session_once)
        self._run(finish, show, self.twitch_notice, 'Checking Twitch authorization…', valid=lambda: self.twitch_login is login)

    def _validate_twitch_session_once(self):
        self._validate_twitch_session()
        return False

    def _validate_twitch_session(self):
        if self.closed:
            return False
        login = self.twitch_login
        if login is not None:
            return True
        def check():
            try:
                return provider_auth.validate_saved_twitch()
            except provider_auth.AuthError as error:
                raise online.ConnectionError(str(error)) from None
        def show(result):
            if result['state'] == 'connected':
                self.twitch_notice.set_text('Saved Twitch login validated.' if result.get('follows') else 'Saved Twitch login validated for discovery. Reconnect with follows permission to import followed channels.')
            else:
                self.twitch_notice.set_text('No saved Twitch login. Begin sign-in or use the Twitch CLI.')
        self._run(check, show, self.twitch_notice, 'Checking saved Twitch login…',
                  valid=lambda: self.twitch_login is login and login is None)
        return True

    def _build_phone(self):
        body = self._section('Phone remote through KDE Connect')
        body.append(text('Use KDE Connect media controls for playback. Add named room commands to a paired phone when you choose.'))
        row = Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.phone_devices = []
        self.phone_choice = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['Find paired phones first'])
        self.phone_choice.set_hexpand(True)
        row.append(self.phone_choice)
        row.append(button('Find paired phones', self.load_phones))
        row.append(button('Install room commands', self.install_phone))
        body.append(row)
        self.phone_notice = text('The phone must be paired and reachable. Existing unrelated remote commands are preserved.')
        body.append(self.phone_notice)
        body.append(text('For links, share from the phone to this desktop, then paste or drop the received URL into Send a link to this room.'))

    def load_phones(self):
        def show(rows):
            self.phone_devices = rows
            self.phone_choice.set_model(Gtk.StringList.new([item['name'] for item in rows] or ['No paired phones reachable']))
            self.phone_notice.set_text(str(len(rows)) + ' paired devices are reachable. Choose one before installing commands.')
        self._run(online.paired_devices, show, self.phone_notice, 'Finding paired phones…')

    def install_phone(self):
        index = self.phone_choice.get_selected()
        if index >= len(self.phone_devices):
            self.phone_notice.set_text('Find and select a paired phone first.')
            return
        device = self.phone_devices[index]
        def show(result):
            self.phone_notice.set_text(str(result['installed']) + ' room commands installed for ' + device['name'] +
                                       ('. Open Run commands on the phone.' if result['notified'] else '. Reopen KDE Connect settings to reload them.'))
        self._run(lambda: online.install_remote_commands(device['id']), show, self.phone_notice, 'Installing room commands…')

    def save_settings(self, service):
        fields = self.settings_widgets[service]
        try:
            online.save_connection(service, {'endpoint': fields['endpoint'].get_text(), 'token_file': fields['token_file'].get_text()})
            secret = fields['token'].get_text()
            if secret:
                online.save_token(service, secret)
                fields['token'].set_text('')
                fields['token_file'].set_text(online.config()[service]['token_file'])
            fields['notice'].remove_css_class('error')
            fields['notice'].set_text('Saved. Test this connection to check its available capabilities.')
            return True
        except online.ConnectionError as error:
            fields['notice'].set_text(str(error))
            fields['notice'].add_css_class('error')
            return False

    def test_settings(self, service):
        if not self.save_settings(service):
            return
        notice = self.settings_widgets[service]['notice']
        def show(result):
            states = ', '.join(key.replace('_', ' ') + ': ' + value for key, value in result['capabilities'].items())
            notice.set_text(result['detail'] + '\n' + states)
        self._run(lambda: online.test_connection(service, self.cancel), show, notice, 'Testing connection…')
"""Twitch discovery and explicit routing into the listening room's lanes."""
import concurrent.futures
import threading
import session_client
import urllib.parse
import re

import gi
gi.require_version('Gtk', '4.0')
from gi.repository import Gtk, GLib

import listening_hub as hub
import ambience
import audio_layers
import twitch_channels as twitch
import channel_browse as browse


def text(value='', css='muted'):
    widget=Gtk.Label(label=value, xalign=0)
    widget.set_wrap(True)
    if css:widget.add_css_class(css)
    return widget


def action(title, callback, tooltip=None):
    widget=Gtk.Button(label=title)
    widget.connect('clicked', callback)
    if tooltip:widget.set_tooltip_text(tooltip)
    return widget


def names(value):
    result=[]
    for item in re.split(r'[\s,;]+', value.strip()):
        if not item:continue
        if '://' in item:
            parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(item)
            if parsed.scheme!='https' or parsed.hostname not in ('twitch.tv','www.twitch.tv') or parsed.query or parsed.fragment or parsed.username or parsed.port:
                raise ValueError('Use Twitch channel names or public channel URLs')
            item=parsed.path.strip('/')
        if not twitch.LOGIN.fullmatch(item):
            raise ValueError('Use Twitch channel names or public channel URLs')
        if item.lower() not in result:result.append(item.lower())
    return result


class TwitchPanel(Gtk.Box):

        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=10)

        self.playing=None

        self.generation=0

        self.cancel=None
        self.updating=False
        self.volume_timer=None

        self.append(top)
        self.notice=text('Find channels to browse live streams or your saved pool.')
        self.append(self.notice)
        filters=Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.search=Gtk.SearchEntry();self.search.set_placeholder_text('Filter channels or titles')
        self.search.set_hexpand(True);self.search.connect('search-changed',self.refresh_list)
        filters.append(self.search)
        self.filter=Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings(['All','Saved'])
        self.filter.connect('notify::selected',self.refresh_list);filters.append(self.filter)
        self.append(filters)
        self.match_count=text('', 'muted')
        self.append(self.match_count)
        scroll=Gtk.ScrolledWindow();scroll.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.NEVER,Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
        scroll.set_min_content_height(160);scroll.set_max_content_height(240)
        scroll.set_propagate_natural_height(True);scroll.set_vexpand(True)

        scroll.set_child(self.channels);self.append(scroll)

        self.play_button=action('Tune in',lambda _:self.play())
        self.play_button.add_css_class('suggested-action');self.play_button.set_sensitive(False)
        row.append(self.play_button);self.append(row)
        editor=Gtk.Expander(label='Manage channels and more')
        body=Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL,spacing=8)
        body.append(text('Channel names or Twitch URLs, separated by commas. Save to keep this style’s pool.'))
        self.curated=Gtk.Entry();self.curated.set_placeholder_text('Channels for the selected style')
        body.append(self.curated)
        self.excluded=Gtk.Entry();self.excluded.set_placeholder_text('Excluded from every shuffle')
        body.append(self.excluded)
        controls=Gtk.FlowBox();controls.set_selection_mode(Gtk.SelectionMode.NONE);controls.set_max_children_per_line(3)
        controls.append(action('Save pool',lambda _:self.save_pool()))
        controls.append(action('Exclude selected from shuffle',lambda _:self.exclude_selected()))
        controls.append(action('Open selected on Twitch',lambda _:self.open_selected()))
        controls.append(action('Open category',lambda _:self.open_category()))
        body.append(controls)
        follows=Gtk.Box(spacing=8)
        self.profile=Gtk.Entry();self.profile.set_text('example');self.profile.set_hexpand(True)
        follows.append(self.profile)
        follows.append(action('Review my follows',lambda _:self.import_follows()))
        body.append(follows)
        body.append(text('Follow imports are suggestions for you to classify. Nothing is added to a style automatically.'))
        editor.set_child(body);self.append(editor)
        mix=Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL,spacing=5)
        self.layer_status=text('Atmosphere · stopped')
        mix.append(self.layer_status)
