        self.pause=action('Play / pause',lambda _:self.layer_control('toggle'))
        levels.append(self.pause)
        levels.append(action('Stop',lambda _:self.stop_layer()))
        mix.append(levels);mixer.append(mix)
        self.load_pool()

    def key(self):return ('music','asmr')[min(self.style.get_selected(),1)]

    def load_pool(self):
        try:
            self.curated.set_text(', '.join(twitch.curated_channels(self.key())))
            self.excluded.set_text(', '.join(twitch.excluded_channels()))
        except (OSError,ValueError) as error:self.notice.set_text(str(error))

    def style_changed(self,*_):
        self.generation+=1
        self.selected=None
        self.result=self.results.get(self.key(), {'channels':[],'status':'unknown'})
        self.route.set_selected(1 if self.key()=='asmr' else 0)
        self.load_pool()
        self.notice.set_text(self.result.get('message') or ('Cached channels' if self.key() in self.results else 'Find channels to begin.'))
        self.refresh_list()

    def save_pool(self):
        try:
            twitch.save_preferences(self.key(),names(self.curated.get_text()),names(self.excluded.get_text()))
            self.notice.set_text('Channel pool saved. Refresh to update live choices.')
            self.refresh_list()
        except (OSError,ValueError) as error:self.notice.set_text(str(error))

    def discover(self):
        try:curated=names(self.curated.get_text())
        except ValueError as error:self.notice.set_text(str(error));return
        self.generation+=1;generation=self.generation;style=self.key()
        self.requests[style]=generation
        self.notice.set_text('Finding channels…')
        def complete(result):
            if self.closed or self.requests.get(style)!=generation:return
            self.results[style]=result
            if style!=self.key():return
            self.result=result
            self.notice.set_text(result.get('message') or f"{len(result['channels'])} live choices in this style")
            self.refresh_list()
        self.app.run_task(lambda:twitch.discover(style,curated=curated),success=complete,executor=self.network)

    def refresh_list(self,*_):
        try:
            saved=names(self.curated.get_text());excluded=names(self.excluded.get_text())
        except ValueError:
            saved=[];excluded=[]
        query=self.search.get_text()
        previous=self.selected['login'] if self.selected else None
        self.visible=browse.project(self.result.get('channels',[]),query,self.filter.get_selected()==1,saved,excluded)
        self.match_count.set_text(f"{len(self.visible)} of {len(self.result.get('channels', []))} channels")
        self.channels.unselect_all()
        while child:=self.channels.get_first_child():self.channels.remove(child)
        selected_row=None
        for channel in self.visible:
            row=Gtk.ListBoxRow();row.channel=channel
            content=Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL,spacing=2)
            content.set_margin_top(5);content.set_margin_bottom(5);content.set_margin_start(8);content.set_margin_end(8)
            heading=Gtk.Label(xalign=0);heading.add_css_class('source-name');heading.set_ellipsize(3)
            display=channel.get('name') or channel['login']
            if display.casefold()!=channel['login'].casefold():display+=' @'+channel['login']
            heading.set_markup(browse.highlight(display,query))
            heading.set_hexpand(True)
            name_line=Gtk.Box(spacing=8);name_line.append(heading)
            content.append(name_line)
            status='Live' if channel.get('live') is True else ('Offline' if channel.get('live') is False else 'Live status unknown')
            flags=[status]
            if channel['saved']:flags.append('Saved')
            if channel['excluded']:flags.append('Excluded from shuffle')
            if self.playing==channel['login']:flags.append('Last started here')
            status_label=text(' · '.join(flags));status_label.set_wrap(False);name_line.append(status_label)
            detail=Gtk.Label(xalign=0);detail.add_css_class('muted');detail.set_ellipsize(3)
            detail.set_markup(browse.highlight(channel.get('title') or channel['url'],query))
            content.append(detail);row.set_child(content);self.channels.append(row)
            if channel['login']==previous:selected_row=row
        if selected_row:self.channels.select_row(selected_row)
        else:self.choose_channel(self.channels,None)

    def choose_channel(self, _box=None, row=None):
        self.selected=row.channel if row else None
        self.play_button.set_sensitive(bool(self.selected) and not self.starting)
        if self.selected:
            self.preview.set_text('Selected: '+self.selected['name']+'\n'+(self.selected.get('title') or self.selected['url']))
        else:self.preview.set_text('Select a channel to preview its details.' if self.visible else 'No matching channels. Change the search or filter, or refresh.')

    def shuffle(self):
        try:excluded=names(self.excluded.get_text())
        except ValueError as error:self.notice.set_text(str(error));return
        last=hub.state().get('last_twitch_channel')
        if last:excluded.append(last)
        chosen=twitch.choose({'channels':self.visible},previous=self.selected['login'] if self.selected else None,excluded=excluded)
        if not chosen:
            self.notice.set_text('No alternative visible channel is available for shuffle.');return
        for index,channel in enumerate(self.visible):
            if channel['login']==chosen['login']:
                self.channels.select_row(self.channels.get_row_at_index(index));break

    def exclude_selected(self):
        if not self.selected:return
        try:
            excluded=names(self.excluded.get_text())
            excluded=list(dict.fromkeys(excluded+[self.selected['login']]))
            twitch.save_preferences(self.key(),names(self.curated.get_text()),excluded)
            self.excluded.set_text(', '.join(excluded));self.refresh_list();self.shuffle()
        except (OSError,ValueError) as error:self.notice.set_text(str(error))

    def open_selected(self):
        if self.selected:self.app.open_source(dict(self.selected,kind='web'))

    def open_category(self):
        self.app.open_source({'kind':'web','url':'https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/'+self.key(),'name':'Twitch '+self.key()})

    def play(self):
        if not self.selected or self.starting:return
        channel=dict(self.selected);destination=self.route.get_selected()
        self.starting=True;self.start_destination=destination
        cancel=threading.Event();self.cancel=cancel;self.play_button.set_sensitive(False)
        pending_volume=None
        if destination==1 and self.volume_timer is not None:
            GLib.source_remove(self.volume_timer);self.volume_timer=None
            pending_volume=self.volume.get_value()
        self.notice.set_text('Opening '+channel['name']+'…')
        if destination==1:self.app.mixer.set_expanded(True)
        def start():
            try:
                if destination==0:
                    session_client.request('link', {'url': channel['url'], 'destination': 'music'})
                elif destination==1:
                    session_client.request('atmosphere', dict(kind='twitch', url=channel['url'], name=channel['name'], **({'volume': pending_volume} if pending_volume is not None else {})))
                else:
                    ambience.start(channel,mode='video',placement='9')
                    hub.update_state(selected='video')
                return {'cancelled':cancel.is_set()}
            except audio_layers.LayerError:
                if cancel.is_set():return {'cancelled':True}
                raise
            finally:GLib.idle_add(self.finish_start,cancel)
        def complete(result):
            if result['cancelled']:self.notice.set_text('Atmosphere stopped.');return
            self.playing=channel['login'];self.refresh_list()
            self.notice.set_text('Playing '+channel['name']+'. Its volume is retained when you switch channels.')
            self.app.run_task(lambda:hub.update_state(last_twitch_channel=channel['login']))
        self.app.run_task(start,success=complete,message='Opening Twitch channel…',executor=self.playback if destination==1 else None)

    def finish_start(self,cancel):
        if cancel is not self.cancel:return False
        self.starting=False
        self.start_destination=None
        if not self.closed:self.play_button.set_sensitive(bool(self.selected))
        return False

    def update_layer(self, current, remembered):
        self.updating=True
        values=current or remembered
        if self.volume_timer is None:self.volume.set_value(values.get('volume',20))
        self.mute.set_label('Unmute' if values.get('muted') else 'Mute')
        loading=self.starting and self.start_destination==1
        self.pause.set_sensitive(bool(current) and not loading)
        self.volume.set_sensitive(not loading)
        self.mute.set_sensitive(not loading)
        self.layer_status.set_text('Atmosphere · '+((current.get('title') or '')+' · '+current.get('status','') if current else 'stopped'))
        self.updating=False

    def volume_changed(self,scale):
        if self.updating:return
        if self.volume_timer is not None:GLib.source_remove(self.volume_timer)
        value=scale.get_value()
        def apply():
            self.volume_timer=None
            self.app.run_task(lambda:session_client.request('layer', {'layer':'atmosphere','action':'volume','value':value}),executor=self.playback)
            return False
        self.volume_timer=GLib.timeout_add(200,apply)

    def layer_control(self,action):
        self.app.run_task(lambda:session_client.request('layer', {'layer':'atmosphere','action':action}),executor=self.playback)

    def cancel_layer_start(self):
        if self.starting and self.start_destination==1 and self.cancel is not None:
            self.cancel.set()
            # Ordered after the start on this lane, covering cancellation as
            # playback becomes ready as well as cancellation during loading.
            self.layer_control('stop')
            return True
        return False

    def stop_layer(self):
        if not self.cancel_layer_start():self.layer_control('stop')

    def import_follows(self):
        profile=self.profile.get_text().strip();style=self.key()
        def complete(result):
            if result['status']!='follows':self.notice.set_text(result['message']);return
            window=Gtk.Window(title='Review follows for '+style,transient_for=self.app.window,modal=True)
            window.set_default_size(520,560)
            body=Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL,spacing=8)
            body.set_margin_top(14);body.set_margin_bottom(14);body.set_margin_start(14);body.set_margin_end(14)
            body.append(text(result.get('message') or 'Select the channels that fit this style.'))
            scroll=Gtk.ScrolledWindow();scroll.set_vexpand(True)
            choices=Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL,spacing=4)
            checks=[]
            for item in result['channels']:
                check=Gtk.CheckButton(label=item['name']+' ('+item['login']+')')
                choices.append(check);checks.append((check,item['login']))
            scroll.set_child(choices);body.append(scroll)
            def add(_):
                try:
                    existing=twitch.curated_channels(style)
                    twitch.save_preferences(style,list(dict.fromkeys(existing+[login for check,login in checks if check.get_active()])),twitch.excluded_channels())
                    self.load_pool();self.notice.set_text('Selected follows added to '+style+'.');window.close()
                except (OSError,ValueError) as error:self.notice.set_text(str(error))
            body.append(action('Add selected to '+style,add));window.set_child(body);window.present()
        self.app.run_task(lambda:twitch.import_following(profile),success=complete,executor=self.network,message='Reading Twitch follows…')

    def close(self):
        self.closed=True
        if self.volume_timer is not None:GLib.source_remove(self.volume_timer)
        self.network.shutdown(wait=False,cancel_futures=True)
        self.playback.shutdown(wait=False,cancel_futures=True)
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Embeddable GTK4 discovery panel for the Radio Browser station directory.

Searches run on a small, panel-owned executor. Construct with the ListeningRoom
controller; playback and favorites are handed back to that controller.
"""
import concurrent.futures
import random

import gi
gi.require_version('Gtk', '4.0')
from gi.repository import Gtk, GLib, Gio, Pango

import listening_hub as hub


COUNTRIES = [
    ('Anywhere', ''),
    ('Finland · FI', 'FI'),
    ('Japan · JP', 'JP'),
    ('United States · US', 'US'),
    ('United Kingdom · GB', 'GB'),
    ('France · FR', 'FR'),
    ('Germany · DE', 'DE'),
    ('Brazil · BR', 'BR'),
    ('Other ISO code…', None),
]


def _label(text='', css=None, xalign=0):
    widget = Gtk.Label(label=text, xalign=xalign)
    if css:
        widget.add_css_class(css)
    return widget


class WorldRadioPanel(Gtk.Box):
    """Country, language, genre and name search for World Radio.

    ``controller`` is the ListeningRoom application/controller. It is expected
    to expose ``open_source(item)``, ``favorite(item, saved)`` and a ``snapshot``
    dict containing its current ``favorites`` list.
    """

    def __init__(self, controller):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=10)
        self.controller = controller
        self.executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(
            max_workers=2, thread_name_prefix='world-radio-search')
        self.closed = False
        self.request_id = 0
        self.results = []
        self.selected_item = None
        self.favorite_buttons = []

        self.set_margin_top(14)
        self.set_margin_bottom(10)
        self.set_margin_start(14)
        self.set_margin_end(14)
        self.set_vexpand(True)

        heading = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=3)
        heading.append(_label('World radio', 'section-title'))
        intro = _label('Find stations by place, language, genre or name. Search only runs when you ask.', 'muted')
        intro.set_wrap(True)
        heading.append(intro)
        self.append(heading)

        filters = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=8)
        self.append(filters)

        place_row = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
        place_row.append(_label('Country', 'muted'))
        self.country = Gtk.DropDown.new_from_strings([entry[0] for entry in COUNTRIES])
        self.country.set_selected(0)
        self.country.connect('notify::selected', self._country_changed)
        self.country.set_tooltip_text('Choose a country or search the full directory')
        self.country.set_hexpand(True)
        place_row.append(self.country)
        self.country_code = Gtk.Entry()
        self.country_code.set_placeholder_text('ISO code, e.g. CA')
        self.country_code.set_max_length(2)
        self.country_code.set_width_chars(12)
        self.country_code.set_visible(False)
        self.country_code.connect('activate', lambda *_: self.search())
        place_row.append(self.country_code)
        filters.append(place_row)

        quick = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
        quick.append(_label('Quick place:', 'muted'))
        for title, code in [('Finland', 'FI'), ('Japan', 'JP'), ('Anywhere', '')]:
            b = Gtk.Button(label=title)
            b.connect('clicked', lambda _, value=code: self._quick_country(value))
            quick.append(b)
        filters.append(quick)

        criteria = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
        self.language = Gtk.Entry()
        self.language.set_placeholder_text('Language, e.g. Finnish')
        self.language.set_hexpand(True)
        self.language.connect('activate', lambda *_: self.search())
        self.genre = Gtk.Entry()
        self.genre.set_placeholder_text('Genre, e.g. jazz')
        self.genre.set_hexpand(True)
        self.genre.connect('activate', lambda *_: self.search())
        criteria.append(self.language)
        criteria.append(self.genre)
        filters.append(criteria)

        name_row = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
        self.name = Gtk.SearchEntry()
        self.name.set_placeholder_text('Station name (optional)')
        self.name.set_hexpand(True)
        self.name.connect('search-changed', self._name_changed)
        name_row.append(self.name)
        self.search_button = Gtk.Button(label='Search stations')
        self.search_button.add_css_class('suggested-action')
        self.search_button.connect('clicked', lambda *_: self.search())
        name_row.append(self.search_button)
        self.surprise_button = Gtk.Button(label='Surprise me')
        self.surprise_button.set_tooltip_text('Choose a station to preview; it will not start until you press Play')
        self.surprise_button.connect('clicked', lambda *_: self.surprise())
        name_row.append(self.surprise_button)
        filters.append(name_row)

        links = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
        garden = Gtk.Button(label='Open Radio Garden')
        garden.set_tooltip_text('Open the Radio Garden website')
        garden.connect('clicked', lambda *_: self._open_uri('https://radio.garden/'))
        links.append(garden)
        links.append(_label('Directory lookup is on demand.', 'muted'))
        filters.append(links)

        self.status = _label('Choose filters and search to browse stations.', 'status-line', xalign=0)
        self.status.set_wrap(True)
        self.append(self.status)

        self.preview = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=4)
        self.preview.set_visible(False)
        self.preview.add_css_class('current')
        self.preview_title = _label('', 'current-title')
        self.preview_title.set_wrap(True)
        self.preview.append(self.preview_title)
        self.preview_details = _label('', 'muted')
        self.preview_details.set_wrap(True)
        self.preview.append(self.preview_details)
        preview_actions = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
        self.preview_play = Gtk.Button(label='Play selected station')
        self.preview_play.add_css_class('suggested-action')
        self.preview_play.connect('clicked', lambda *_: self._play(self.selected_item))
        preview_actions.append(self.preview_play)
        self.preview.append(preview_actions)
        self.append(self.preview)

        self.result_list = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=2)
        self.results_scroll = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        self.results_scroll.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.NEVER, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
        self.results_scroll.set_vexpand(True)
        self.results_scroll.set_hexpand(True)
        self.results_scroll.set_min_content_height(120)
        self.results_scroll.set_child(self.result_list)
        self.append(self.results_scroll)

    def _country_changed(self, *_):
        selected = self.country.get_selected()
        self.country_code.set_visible(selected == len(COUNTRIES) - 1)
        if selected == len(COUNTRIES) - 1:
            self.country_code.grab_focus()

    def _quick_country(self, code):
        if not code:
            self.country.set_selected(0)
            self.country_code.set_text('')
        else:
            position = next((i for i, (_, value) in enumerate(COUNTRIES) if value == code), None)
            if position is None:
                self.country.set_selected(len(COUNTRIES) - 1)
                self.country_code.set_text(code)
            else:
                self.country.set_selected(position)
        # Quick place buttons only prefill the search criteria.

    def _country_value(self):
        selected = self.country.get_selected()
        if selected == len(COUNTRIES) - 1:
            return self.country_code.get_text().strip().upper()
        return COUNTRIES[selected][1] if selected < len(COUNTRIES) else ''

    def _name_changed(self, *_):
        # SearchEntry emits this while typing; keep it a form, never a live query.
        return

    def _query_values(self):
        return {
            'name': self.name.get_text().strip(),
            'country': self._country_value(),
            'language': self.language.get_text().strip(),
            'tag': self.genre.get_text().strip(),
        }

    def search(self, surprise=False):
        if self.closed:
            return
        values = self._query_values()
        query = values.pop('name')
        # Even a rejected submission supersedes an earlier in-flight search.
        self.request_id += 1
        request_id = self.request_id
        if not query and not any(values.values()):
            if not surprise:
                self.search_button.set_sensitive(True)
                self.surprise_button.set_sensitive(True)
                self.status.set_text('Pick a filter or enter a station name before searching.')
                self.status.add_css_class('error')
                return
        self.search_button.set_sensitive(False)
        self.surprise_button.set_sensitive(False)
        self.status.remove_css_class('error')
        self.status.set_text('Searching the station directory…')

        def lookup():
            return hub.search_radio(query, **values)

        future = self.executor.submit(lookup)
        future.add_done_callback(lambda completed: self._search_finished(request_id, completed, surprise))

    def _search_finished(self, request_id, future, surprise):
        try:
            results, error = future.result(), None
        except Exception as exc:
            results, error = None, str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
        GLib.idle_add(self._apply_search, request_id, results, error, surprise)

    def _apply_search(self, request_id, results, error, surprise):
        if self.closed or request_id != self.request_id:
            return False
        self.search_button.set_sensitive(True)
        self.surprise_button.set_sensitive(True)
        self._clear_results()
        if error:
            self.results = []
            self._select(None)
            self.status.set_text('Search failed: ' + error)
            self.status.add_css_class('error')
            return False
        self.status.remove_css_class('error')
        self.results = results or []
        if not self.results:
            self._select(None)
            self.status.set_text('No stations found. Try another country, language, genre or name.')
            self.result_list.append(_label('No stations matched these filters.', 'muted'))
            return False
        self.status.set_text(f'Found {len(self.results)} stations. Select one to preview, then press Play.')
        for item in self.results:
            self.result_list.append(self._result_row(item))
        if surprise:
            self._select(random.choice(self.results))
        else:
            self._select(None)
        return False

    def _clear_results(self):
        self.favorite_buttons.clear()
        child = self.result_list.get_first_child()
        while child:
            following = child.get_next_sibling()
            self.result_list.remove(child)
            child = following

    def _result_row(self, item):
        row = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
        row.add_css_class('source-row')
        body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=2)
        body.set_hexpand(True)
        name_button = Gtk.Button(label=item.get('name') or 'Unnamed station')
        name_button.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
        name_button.set_hexpand(True)
        name_button.add_css_class('flat')
        name_button.add_css_class('source-name')
        name_button.get_child().set_ellipsize(Pango.EllipsizeMode.END)
        name_button.set_tooltip_text(item.get('url') or '')
        name_button.connect('clicked', lambda *_args, station=item: self._select(station))
        body.append(name_button)
        metadata = _label(self._station_metadata(item), 'muted')
        metadata.set_ellipsize(Pango.EllipsizeMode.END)
        body.append(metadata)
        row.append(body)
        play = Gtk.Button(label='Play')
        play.connect('clicked', lambda *_args, station=item: self._play(station))
        row.append(play)
        saved = item.get('url') in self._favorite_urls()
        favorite = Gtk.Button(label='★' if saved else '☆')
        favorite.set_tooltip_text('Remove from favorites' if saved else 'Save to favorites')
        def toggle_favorite(button, station=item):
            self._favorite(station, station.get('url') in self._favorite_urls())
        favorite.connect('clicked', toggle_favorite)
        self.favorite_buttons.append((favorite, item.get('url')))
        row.append(favorite)
        website = item.get('website')
        if hub.valid_url(website):
            web = Gtk.Button(label='Website')
            web.set_tooltip_text('Open the station website')
            web.connect('clicked', lambda *_args, station=item: self._open_website(station))
            row.append(web)
        return row

    @staticmethod
    def _station_metadata(item):
        pieces = []
        country = item.get('country') or item.get('countrycode')
        if country:
            pieces.append(str(country))
        language = item.get('language')
        if language:
            pieces.append(str(language))
        tags = item.get('tags') or []
        if isinstance(tags, str):
            tags = [tag.strip() for tag in tags.split(',') if tag.strip()]
        if tags:
            pieces.append(' · '.join(str(tag) for tag in tags[:4]))
        return '  ·  '.join(pieces) or 'Station details unavailable'

    def _select(self, item):
        self.selected_item = item
        if not item:
            self.preview.set_visible(False)
            return
        self.preview.set_visible(True)
        self.preview_title.set_text(item.get('name') or 'Unnamed station')
        self.preview_details.set_text(self._station_metadata(item))
        self.preview_play.set_sensitive(True)

    def surprise(self):
        if self.results:
            self._select(random.choice(self.results))
            self.status.set_text('A station is selected for preview. Press Play when you want to listen.')
            self.status.remove_css_class('error')
            return
        # Surprise browse is an explicit directory search, with no audio action.
        self.search(surprise=True)

    def _favorite_urls(self):
        snapshot = getattr(self.controller, 'snapshot', {}) or {}
        favorites = snapshot.get('favorites', []) if isinstance(snapshot, dict) else []
        return {item.get('url') for item in favorites if isinstance(item, dict)}

    def update_snapshot(self):
        """Refresh favorite indicators after the controller updates its snapshot."""
        if self.closed:
            return
        urls = self._favorite_urls()
        for button, url in self.favorite_buttons:
            saved = url in urls
            button.set_label('★' if saved else '☆')
            button.set_tooltip_text('Remove from favorites' if saved else 'Save to favorites')

    def _favorite(self, item, saved):
        if not item:
            return
        method = getattr(self.controller, 'favorite', None)
        if method:
            method(item, saved)
        else:
            action = (lambda: hub.save_json(
                hub.STATE / 'favorites.json',
                [entry for entry in hub.favorites() if entry.get('url') != item.get('url')])) if saved \
                else (lambda: hub.save_favorite(item))
            self._run_action(action)
        self.status.set_text('Favorite update requested. The room snapshot will refresh shortly.')

    def _play(self, item):
        if item:
            self.controller.open_source(item)

    def _open_website(self, item):
        website = item.get('website', '')
        if not hub.valid_url(website):
            return
        self.controller.open_source(dict(item, kind='web', url=website))

    def _run_action(self, action):
        run_task = getattr(self.controller, 'run_task', None)
        if run_task:
            run_task(action, message='Updating favorites…')
        else:
            future = self.executor.submit(action)
            future.add_done_callback(lambda f: GLib.idle_add(
                self._action_finished, None if f.exception() is None else str(f.exception())))

    def _action_finished(self, error):
        if self.closed:
            return False
        self.status.set_text('Favorite updated.' if error is None else 'Could not update favorite: ' + error)
        if error:
            self.status.add_css_class('error')
        return False

    def _open_uri(self, uri):
        try:
            Gio.AppInfo.launch_default_for_uri(uri, None)
        except GLib.Error as exc:
            self.status.set_text('Could not open website: ' + str(exc))
            self.status.add_css_class('error')

    def focus_search(self):
        """Focus the station name field for an optional global shortcut."""
        self.name.grab_focus()

    def close(self):
        """Stop accepting results and release the panel's search workers."""
        if self.closed:
            return
        self.closed = True
        self.request_id += 1
        self.executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
